At the {wiki:Festival of Initiates} on the Isle of Destiny, four instructors let you try out each vocation's fighting style: sword and shield with {npc:Neill}, staff with {npc:Tylius}, spears with {npc:Shanoya}, and runes and spells with {npc:Salbra}. You test everything on {creature:Party Skeleton|Party Skeletons}, and at the end you choose your vocation.
One of the easiest quests in Rookgaard: enter the village sewers, get past a few {creature:Rat|Rats} and open a box half-hidden behind rubble to receive a {item:Combat Knife}.

While this Mini World Change is active, the {item:Energy Gate} in {wiki:Vengoth} opens and you can trade {item:Tentacle Piece|Tentacle Pieces} with the {npc:Dread Guardian} to fight alone against one of the incarnations of {creature:Devovorga}. Each boss you defeat gives you a **Slayer of ...** achievement and Bosstiary points.

With the Mini World Change active: enter the {item:Energy Gate} in Vengoth and trade {item:Tentacle Piece|Tentacle Pieces} with the {npc:Dread Guardian} for the boss you want (Anmothra, Chikhaton, Irahsae, Phrodomo or Teneshpar).
Only on days when the Mini World Change is active. You need access to {wiki:Vengoth} (mission 4 of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest|Blood Brothers Quest}).

{npc:Tom}, Rookgaard's tanner, says an adventurer left a {item:Doublet} in the stable cellar before leaving for the mainland. Go down to the stable north of Tom's shop and use the loose board to get the doublet. There are no monsters on the way.
Stable stairs north of Tom's shop
Stable stairs north of Tom's shop
Depends on the 20 Years a Cook Quest and on getting the addon items

The {wiki:Draccoon Herald Outfits|Draccoon Herald Outfit} is tied to the {wiki:20 Years a Cook Quest}: completing it unlocks the base outfit. You get the two addons by using two items: the {item:Heralds Wings} (wings) and the {item:Heralds Insignia} (staff). The quest also gives the achievement The Rule of Raccool.
Several weeks (depends on the points you earn from Weekly Tasks)

The {wiki:Falconer Outfits|Falconer Outfit} and its two addons are not earned from NPCs: you buy each piece in the Hunting Task Shop of the {wiki:Task Board} with Hunting Task Points, which you accumulate by completing Weekly Tasks. The full outfit costs 170,000 points and gives the achievement Falconer.
Several weeks (depends on the Weekly Tasks)

The {wiki:Feral Trapper Outfits|Feral Trapper Outfit} and its two addons are not earned on an adventure: they are bought with **Hunting Task Points** in the Hunting Task Shop of the {wiki:Task Board}. You collect points by completing Weekly Tasks; when you buy the full outfit (170,000 points in total) you get the achievement **Feral Trapper**.
Ongoing — weeks or months (repeatable tasks at every level)

The dangerous creatures that infest the world are growing more and more threatening, and several NPCs ask for help in thinning them out. The centre of this system is the Paw and Fur Society run by {npc:Grizzly Adams} in Port Hope: you do hunting tasks according to your level, earn points, climb ranks and unlock bosses. On top of that, there are rankless tasks given by other NPCs. You receive experience, money, access to bosses, the {item:Demon Backpack}, the {item:Holy Icon}, trips with {npc:Lorek}, the right to sell trophies and many achievements.
Grizzly Adams, Port Hope (1 floor up)
Grizzly Adams, Port Hope (1 floor up)
Paw and Fur Society task bosses

When you hand in each boss task to {npc:Grizzly Adams}; if you already have the maximum rank for your level, say {key:boss} after the task and choose a boss from your bracket (or from the lower ones).
You can only have one task for each boss active at a time.
Selling trophies and creature products to Grizzly Adams
From the **Huntsman** rank (10 points), with {key:trade}; the list grows at the **Big Game Hunter** (40) and **Trophy Hunter** (70) ranks.
Lorek's boat from Port Hope to Banuta, Chor and the mountain pass to Darama
**Trophy Hunter** rank (70 points, level 80), which also gives you the first {item:Demon Backpack}.
Special tasks for Demodras and Tiquandas Revenge
When you hand in the 6666 Demons task you receive the {item:Holy Icon}, which is needed for this quest.
Depends on your luck with the boss loot

The {wiki:Makeshift Warrior Outfits|Makeshift Warrior Outfits} are obtained by using three rare items dropped by the bosses of Warzones 4, 5 and 6 of the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub|Gnome Deep Hub}: a blueprint for the armour, wooden planks for the shield and weapon, and a pot to use as a helmet. With the outfit you also get the achievement **Cobbled and Patched**.
Very long (dozens of hours, at your own pace)

An exploration quest covering the whole Tibia map, tracked on the {wiki:Cyclopedia|Cyclopedia} map. You discover subareas by finding 7 *Points of Interest* in each one, and by completing whole areas you unlock map information, raid warnings and achievements. After 10, 15 and 20 areas, {npc:Charos} gives you the {wiki:Discoverer Outfits|Discoverer Outfits} and the two addons.
Extra information on the Cyclopedia map (NPCs, passages and creatures)
Per area: with **30%** discovered you see the NPC positions; with **70%** the passages to other floors and the teleports; with **100%** the list of creatures in each subarea.
When you discover **100%** of an area: a warning 1 hour before a raid in that area and, 15 minutes before, the exact subarea.
It does not work for underground raids.

In {wiki:Newhaven|Newhaven}, a cave-in has revealed a new area above the {wiki:Corrupted Mines|Corrupted Mines}. Go up with the rope, cross the poisonous gas wall and the cave to the very end, and search the body of a human to get a {item:Legion Helmet}.

Every six months the dragon Nimmersatt gets distracted and players can invade his lair, northwest of Carlin. The goal is to collect {item:Snowball|Snowballs} in the north of the dungeon and throw them at the {item:Lava Wall} next to the entrance until it comes down. The reward is a chance to get the {item:Bottled Dragon Breath}, which is needed for the {wiki:Dragon Slayer Outfits} made by {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops}.
Dragon Slayer Outfits (the Bottled Dragon Breath is required)
If you get the {item:Bottled Dragon Breath} at the event, take it to {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} for the {wiki:Dragon Slayer Outfits}.
It is only a chance of getting the bottle; the event happens every 6 months.
One of the first quests in Rookgaard: go down into the village sewers, get past the rats and open the quest chest to receive a {item:Rapier}.
Daily (the portal stays open all day)

Every day a portal opens to the {wiki:Spirit Grounds}, a hunting area full of undead and nightmare creatures. The portal can appear near Darashia (Darama), in the Ghostlands or in Vengoth. There are no objectives or known achievements: it is simply a place to hunt, with creatures that change regardless of which portal is open.
On days when the Mini World Change is active, through the portal open that day (Darama, Ghostlands or Vengoth).
Premium only. The Vengoth portal requires access to {wiki:Vengoth} (mission 4 of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest|Blood Brothers Quest}).

Every year, from 7 to 10 January, Tibia celebrates its birthday in Thais. Collect {item:Old Rag|Old Rags} to summon {creature:Piñata Dragon|Piñata Dragons} (with a 15% experience bonus for the whole server and exclusive items such as the {item:Festive Backpack}) and take {npc:Kendra}'s boat to the islands {wiki:Vigintia} and {wiki:Nostalgia}, with mini-games, unique prizes and an arena with old sprites.

The optional tutorial for new characters, played in a cave of crystals and lava beneath {wiki:Dawnport|Dawnport}. You learn to walk, pick up items, attack, loot, eat and talk to NPCs, and at the end you are teleported to Dawnport with a {item:Backpack}, a {item:Rope}, a {item:Torch} and 3 {item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins}.

When {npc:Amber} arrived in Rookgaard on her raft, she forgot her notebook. Fetch it from the chest on the dock east of the village and return it to her at the Academy: in exchange she gives you a {item:Short Sword}.

{npc:Vascalir}, at the Rookgaard Academy, needs help stopping the orc shaman {creature:Kraknaknork}, who is terrorising Rookgaard. Over several missions you load catapults, kill rats, deliver herbs, steal silk from the {creature:Spider Queen}, save the library from fire, bring down the troll tunnel and prepare the invasion of the orc fortress. In the end you defeat Kraknaknork and get a full set of equipment to leave the island.

{npc:Mr Morris}, at the Adventurer's Outpost in Dawnport, needs help with his investigation. He offers 3 collection missions (amulet, logbook and herbs), 3 hunting missions (trolls, goblins and minotaurs) and also the search for the dormitory key. Each of the 7 missions gives 50 gold coins, 350 in total.
Mr Morris, 2nd floor of the Adventurer's Outpost
Mr Morris, 2nd floor of the Adventurer's Outpost

The first quest for anyone starting in {wiki:Newhaven|Newhaven}. You help the guard {npc:Gustavo, The Guard} drive off the goblins of the Muglex Clan and recover the book stolen from teacher {npc:Viola}, while levelling up to level 8 so you can travel to {wiki:Targuna|Targuna}. You receive a {item:Guardian Ring}, a {item:Scarf} and 1,600 experience points.
Trade quest in Rookgaard: pick a {item:Banana} from a {item:Bananapalm} and take it to {npc:Willie}, the village farmer, who swaps it for a {item:Studded Shield}.

In Rookgaard, {npc:Al Dee} will only swap a {item:Pick} for a good-quality {item:Small Axe}. Find a Small Axe in one of the island's many caves (or from a {creature:Goblin}) and take it to Al Dee to get your pick.

An old captain hid some of his most precious belongings in the depths of Rookgaard. Go down through the {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} tower, cross the poisonous gases, face two {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and open the chests to receive salmon and the book {item:Treasure of Captain Iglue (Book)}. The salmon can be traded with {npc:Amber} for information about the orcs' language.
Poison Spiders tower, north of Rookgaard
Poison Spiders tower, north of Rookgaard

Right in the middle of Rookgaard's wilderness, beneath the bear cave, there is a {item:Dead Dragon|dead dragon} surrounded by fire fields. Cross the fire, open the dragon's body and take a {item:Bag} with a {item:Copper Shield} and a {item:Legion Helmet}.

{npc:Tom}, Rookgaard's tanner, uses bear paws and can make you a pair of your own. Bring him 50 {item:Bear Paw|Bear Paws} and 50 {item:Wolf Paw|Wolf Paws} and you get the first addon (Paws) of the {wiki:Druid Outfits}, the same one you earn from {npc:Ustan} on the mainland.

Somebody in Rookgaard loves flowers, especially honey flowers... Climb the wasp tower in the northwest of the island, pick a {item:Honey Flower} at the top and swap it with {npc:Lee'Delle} for some {item:Studded Legs}.

A classic Rookgaard quest in the island's main cave. Go down several floors through the cave full of trolls, orcs and minotaurs, get the {item:Key 4601} (or use a {item:Pick} to fetch it), open the way to the bear room, kill the {creature:Bear} and open the three boxes to receive a {item:Chain Armor}, a {item:Brass Helmet}, arrows and gold.

In Rookgaard you can earn both addons of the Citizen outfit, the same ones you earn on the mainland. {npc:Norma} teaches you to make the feathered hat in exchange for chicken feathers, honeycombs and a helmet, and {npc:Amber} makes you the backpack from 100 minotaur leathers.
Norma, north of the Rookgaard Academy
Norma, north of the Rookgaard Academy

Rookgaard quest in the Premium area. Enter through the Premium troll cave, cross a bridge while {creature:Goblin|Goblins} pelt you with stones, go down into the goblin temple and climb up to the chest room. You receive 50 gp, 4 {item:Snowball|Snowballs}, 5 {item:Small Stone|Small Stones}, some {item:Sandals}, a {item:Pan} and a {item:Vial} of milk.

A classic Rookgaard quest: a warrior entered a cave, met monsters he could not beat, and his equipment was left where he died. Cross the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} cave beneath the graves in the northeast of the island and take a {item:Katana} and a {item:Viking Helmet} from the bodies. Along the way you pick up the {item:Key 4603}.
Graves in the northeast of the island
Graves in the northeast of the island

Also known as the Carlin Sword Quest. Go down through Rookgaard's big cave, cross the wolf labyrinth and enter the Minotaur Hell, full of minotaurs, orcs and wolves. At the bottom, three quest boxes hold a {item:Carlin Sword}, a {item:Fishing Rod} and a bag of arrows. It is probably the hardest quest in Rookgaard.
Big cave entrance in Rookgaard (north of the level 2 bridge)
Big cave entrance in Rookgaard (north of the level 2 bridge)

{npc:Seymour}, head of the Rookgaard Academy, is looking for a suitable gift box to offer the king. You get the {item:Present} from a chest near the Bear Room Quest and swap it with Seymour for a {item:Legion Helmet} (or keep the present as a collector's item).
5–10 min (if you already have the frying pan)

The farmer {npc:Billy}, in Rookgaard, rewards anyone who helps him: swap a {item:Pan} (frying pan) from the Goblin Temple Quest for a {item:Small Health Potion}, in case you eat anything cooked by his cousin.
Event from 21 to 26 February; the individual mission takes 30–60 min

Annual world event: {creature:Cake Golem|Cake Golems} invade five cities. Players gather sugary substances and lure golems into extraction machines until a bridge is built to the {wiki:Cake Keep Isle}, south of Cormaya, where the whole world has to eat a giant four-layer cake. If the world succeeds, it gets a seven-day bonus and each player can do {npc:Brutus The Baker}'s mission to choose a cake item and a cupcake.

Monthly event in which you help a cursed pirate free his soul by sailing a ghost ship across the oceans of the afterlife. You collect {creature:Spectral Scum|Spectral Scums} in the cities, form a crew of 4 players with the same soul mark and keep the ship intact for 5 minutes. Each successful trip gives 20 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} and a {item:Pirate Bag}, and there are 4 achievements to earn.
Thais lighthouse (Smaralda is just to the south)
Thais lighthouse (Smaralda is just to the south)
15–30 min per day during the event

Every October, the Combined Magical Winterberry Society asks players to collect {item:Bunch of Winterberries|Bunches of Winterberries} and stomp them in a vat to make the magical juice used in potions. It is a world quest: if the server stomps 40 loads (4,000 bunches), {wiki:Health Potions|Health Potions} and {wiki:Mana Potions|Mana Potions} become 33% stronger for 7 days. Taking part for 3 years gives the achievement **Berry Picker**.
Emilie, west of Thais' north gate
Emilie, west of Thais' north gate

Someone died in the Thais sewers while carrying an axe. Go down into the sewers near the depot, open a hidden hole with a {item:Pick}, kill 4 {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats} and take a {item:Battle Axe} from a pile of bones.
Southwest tip of the Thais sewers
Southwest tip of the Thais sewers

Annual event (world quest) in which the whole server helps the witches of the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp} prepare a powerful spirit potion. You gather exotic ingredients in the cauldron and protect the room from the {creature:Bane Bringer|Bane Bringers}. You earn favour points to trade for potions and for a Raven with {npc:Minzy}, up to 8 achievements and, if the world succeeds, +50% experience for 10 days.
One of the entrances to the event area (Green Claw Swamp)
One of the entrances to the event area (Green Claw Swamp)
10–20 min (while the world change is active)

Mini world change in which the witch {npc:Wyda}, in the Green Claw Swamp, is bored. While it is active, you can hand her {item:Blood Herb|Blood Herbs} for a chance to receive a {item:Torn Teddy} (achievement **Torn Treasures**) and kill the fake giant spiders that appear around her house (achievement **Someone's Bored**).
5–15 min per trade (not counting collecting the items)

Several NPCs scattered around the world trade items dropped by monsters for useful {wiki:Quest Items|quest items}, such as the {item:Magic Sulphur}, the {item:Enchanted Chicken Wing} or the {item:Spider Silk Yarn}. This page gathers the most common trades: collect the requested items, go to the right NPC and make the trade.

A member of the Explorer Society drank too much and may have died in a brawl in The Jolly Axeman tavern in Kazordoon. Go down through one of the tavern's sewers, kill the rat and recover the {item:Explorer Brooch} from the body. You can then hand it to {npc:Mortimer} for 50 gold.

Some {creature:Troll|Trolls} stole a {item:Fanfare} and hid it beneath Carlin's cemetery. Pick up the {item:Key 3520} near the harbour, go down into the cemetery crypt, find the hole and follow the path to the chest with the Fanfare. A simple quest, great for low-level characters.
Box with Key 3520, near the Carlin boat
Box with Key 3520, near the Carlin boat
5 minutes (if you already have the gold)

The {wiki:Golden Outfits|Golden Outfit} is not earned by fighting: it is bought with a gigantic donation to one of the monarchs — {npc:King Tibianus} (Thais), {npc:Queen Eloise} (Carlin) or {npc:Emperor Kruzak} (Kazordoon). The armour costs 500,000,000 gp and each addon (boots and helmet) another 250,000,000 gp. Besides the outfit you receive the matching {item:The Golden Outfit Display (Basic)|The Golden Outfit Display} and your name is engraved on the {wiki:Memorial|Memorials}.
King Tibianus, Thais castle (or Queen Eloise / Emperor Kruzak)
King Tibianus, Thais castle (or Queen Eloise / Emperor Kruzak)
Ongoing (the state changes as players rent horses)

Also known as the Horse Taming Quest. The horses in the stables can be rented, but sometimes they run away to roam with the wild horses and have to be rounded up again. While the horses are loose, {creature:Wild Horse|Wild Horses} appear around Thais' {wiki:Horse Station}, which you can tame with {item:Sugar Oat} to get the {wiki:War Horse} mount. When they are in the stable, the whole server (including Free accounts) can rent horses.
When the horses are locked in the stable (enough players have rented horses or the loose horses have been rounded up in the {wiki:Horse Station} corral).
Applies to the whole server, including Free accounts; it stops being available when the horses run away.
While the horses are loose: tame a {creature:Wild Horse} near the Thais Horse Station with {item:Sugar Oat}.

{npc:Muriel}, of the Thais sorcerer guild, is researching a new spell against the undead and needs a defiled bone. Take his container to the Cursed Bone Pit, in the underground north of Thais, dig until you find a well-preserved human skeleton and bring him the sample to receive a {item:Death Ring}.

The dwarven miners may have left traces of what they extracted. Go down into the northernmost mine outside Kazordoon, fight your way through {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves} and {creature:Bat|Bats} to the northwest and open the chest to receive an {item:Iron Ore}.
One day (the event lasts until server save)

On **Kingsday**, Thais is decorated to celebrate {npc:King Tibianus}. During the day the NPCs in Thais speak differently, there are hourly raids in the Knights' Guild arena, and anyone who greets the king gets the achievement **Loyal Subject**. Be careful: anyone who insults the king ends up in Thais prison.

The {item:Marlin} is a rare fish associated with the island of {wiki:Goroma|Goroma}. Take it to the fisherman {npc:Pemaret}, on the Cormaya boat, and he turns it into a {item:Marlin Trophy} for you to decorate your house wall.
5 min (if you already have the money)

The addons of the {wiki:Nobleman Outfits|Nobleman/Noblewoman Outfit} do not require adventures: you buy them from the stylist {npc:Irmana}, in the Venore fashion house, for 150,000 gp each. You can pay everything at once or in 15 instalments of 10,000 gp. With both addons you get the achievement **Aristocrat**.

Sometimes {npc:Noodles}, {npc:King Tibianus}' dog, runs away from the castle and wanders all over the Thais peninsula. Ask the king for a leash, find Noodles, use the leash on him and go back to the king to receive experience, gold (or, if you are lucky, a {item:Fan Doll of Queen Eloise}) and the achievement Dog Sitter.

A two-step trade to get the {item:Obsidian Knife}, the knife used to skin creatures. {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops}, in Ab'Dendriel, turns a {item:Dragon Shield} into a {item:Piece of Draconian Steel}; then {npc:Uzgod}, in Kazordoon, combines the steel with an {item:Obsidian Lance} and forges the knife for you.
One-week event (each game takes 2–15 min, with cooldowns from 15 min to 20 h)

Orcsoberfest is a seasonal event on {wiki:Orcsoberfest Island|Orcsoberfest Island}, where the brutish {creature:Orger|Orgers} organise "games" that are just excuses to eat and drink. You take part in fishing, hammers, races, sausage contests and King Chuck's banquet to earn {wiki:Festive Point|Festive Points}, which you trade with {npc:Xaver} for rewards. Each edition you take part in also gives you a piece of the Traditional Set and, every two, a part of the Orcsoberfest Garb outfit.
Tent south of Thais (trip to Orcsoberfest Island)
Tent south of Thais (trip to Orcsoberfest Island)

From time to time the eastern merchant {npc:Yasir} anchors his boat next to the port of Ankrahmun, Carlin or Liberty Bay. While he is there, he buys almost all {wiki:Creature Products|creature products} from you. Just talk to him to get the achievement Si, Ariki!.
5 min per part (once you have the tokens)

The artists {npc:Percybald} (Carlin) and {npc:Alyxo} (Issavi) give you the {wiki:Royal Costume Outfits|Royal Costume Outfits} and their addons in exchange for donations of {item:Silver Token|Silver Tokens} and {item:Gold Token|Gold Tokens}. The full outfit costs 30,000 Silver Tokens and 25,000 Gold Tokens, and your name is added to the {wiki:Memorial|Memorials}.

A small quest in the {wiki:Serpentine Tower|Serpentine Tower}, the sorcerers' guild of Ankrahmun. Put a pot on the fire to activate a magic field that takes you to a hidden room with a chest: inside is a {item:White Pearl}. The tower also holds an unsolved mystery involving caged creatures and levers.
Serpentine Tower, southeast of the Ankrahmun depot
Serpentine Tower, southeast of the Ankrahmun depot

{npc:Sinatuki}, a Chakoya banished from her tribe, lives in {wiki:Nibelor|Nibelor} and is very hungry. Give her 100 fish ({item:Green Perch|Green Perches} or {item:Rainbow Trout|Rainbow Trouts}) and she rewards you with 5 {item:Shard|Shards} and the achievement **Jamjam**.
1-week event (around 16 to 23 April); the nest hunt takes 1–3 hours

Tibia's spring event (the former Easter event). For one week, dragon nests appear in the Dragon Lairs and hatch {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings} (which give 25% more experience), rabbits drop {item:Coloured Egg|Coloured Eggs} and there are {item:Hidden Nest|Hidden Nests} hidden around the cities. Find them to get {item:Surprise Nest|Surprise Nests} with sweets, chocolates, eggs and {item:Surprise Bag (Blue)|Blue Surprise Bags}.

Swamp fever strikes the poorest people of Venore, and {npc:Ottokar}, at the city's asylum, fights it with pouches of medicine. While the fever spreads, {creature:Feverish Citizen|Feverish Citizens} appear around the city and may drop pieces of cloth for the {wiki:Afflicted Outfits Quest|Afflicted Outfits}. If you bring {item:Medicine Pouch|Medicine Pouches} to Ottokar, you receive bags with the belongings of the sick, which may contain {item:Slug Drug} to tame a mount.

While this Mini World Change is active, the snow on the glacier north of Svargrond starts to melt and reveals grass and rare plants. 15 {item:Ice Flower|Ice Flowers} appear which, when used, may give {item:Ice Flower Seeds}. Harvest 10 successfully to get the achievement Ice Harvester.
First Ice Flower, west of the path to Svargrond
First Ice Flower, west of the path to Svargrond
8-day event (15–23 March and 15–23 September) + 7 days of rewards

Twice-yearly world event: three sorcerers, Furb of Fun (orange), Feiz of Power (violet) and Fern of Nature (green), compete to see who has the most followers. You collect coloured powders from envelopes dropped by monsters, mark yourself with a colour and combine the rest of the powder with another player of a different colour to join a sorcerer. The winner gives the whole server a week-long bonus and you earn points to trade for {item:Zaoan Chess Piece|Zaoan Chess Pieces}.
Paulette, next to the knights' guild in Thais
Paulette, next to the knights' guild in Thais

{npc:Eclesius}, an absent-minded sorcerer who lives near Thais, is looking for a new assistant. The quest has two parts: five short chores you can repeat every day (sweeping, polishing, feeding the fish, exterminating bats and "preventing the apocalypse") and six missions that take you to Venore, Ab'Dendriel, Kazordoon and Carlin. In total you earn about 5350 gp and 10650 experience points.
Depends on collecting items; 2 hours of waiting for the backpack

The addons of the {wiki:Citizen Outfits|Citizen Outfit}, every player's basic outfit. {npc:Lubo} makes you a minotaur leather backpack if you bring him 100 {item:Minotaur Leather}, and {npc:Hanna}, in Thais, makes you the feathered hat from a {item:Legion Helmet}, chicken feathers and honeycombs. The quest also gives the achievement **Exemplary Citizen**.

The scientist {npc:Spectulus}, of the Edron Academy, lost his intern {npc:Jack} in an experiment with a time machine. You help convince Jack of who he "really" is: you decorate his house with old furniture, talk to his family and destroy his sculpture. At the end you receive 6000 experience, a {item:Piece of Marble Rock} and one of two achievements, depending on whether you tell Jack the truth or lie to him.
South of Thais there is a suspicious raft guarded by {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}. On top of it are two boxes: the light brown one has a {item:Minotaur Leather} waiting for you.
A short quest near Thais. Enter a cave west of the Ancient Temple entrance, follow it to a room with a well, go down the well and open the chests guarded by scorpions to receive a {item:Scale Armor}.
Hole west of the Ancient Temple entrance (Thais)
Hole west of the Ancient Temple entrance (Thais)
The trolls of the {wiki:Thais Troll Cave} hide their precious silver necklace from intruders. Enter the cave, go down to the southeast cellar and open the box to receive a {item:Silver Amulet}.
Depends on the honeycomb hunt (1–2 hours)

The mermaid {npc:Marina}, of the island of {wiki:Meriana|Meriana}, knows how to turn spider silk into yarn, but hates touching sticky things. Praise her beauty and bring her 50 {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs}: from then on, she swaps 10 {item:Spider Silk} for a {item:Spool of Yarn} whenever you like.
Swapping Spider Silk for Spool of Yarn with Marina
When you hand 50 {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs} to {npc:Marina}, in Meriana.
10 {item:Spider Silk} for 1 {item:Spool of Yarn}, whenever you like ({key:silk yarn}).

{npc:Boozer}, owner of the Hard Rock Racing Track in Venore, needs a new attraction and wants to find out the dwarves' secret beer recipe. Take his bottle to the Kazordoon brewery, fill it from the {item:Cask of Brown Ale} barrel and bring the sample back. You receive a {item:Light Shovel}, 10 Platinum Coins and 100 experience.
Mission *The Good Guard* of The Hidden City of Beregar Quest
During that mission you buy the {item:Dwarven Ale} from {npc:Boozer}, in Venore (3000 gp).

General {npc:Bunny Bonecrusher}, of Carlin, sends you to deliver a package of supplies to the Femor Hills watchtower. There, {npc:Thanita} will only give you the delivery password if you rid her of the {creature:Goblin Leader}, whom you have to make leave his room by setting fire to his bed. As a reward you receive 200 elemental arrows.

The trolls destroyed {npc:Jerom}'s house, northeast of Edron, just as he was planning to open a new shop. Swim under the mountain with a diving helmet, jump to the top with {item:Boots of Haste} and convince {npc:Chief Grarkharok} to return Jerom's family necklace. You receive an {item:Elvenhair Rope}. It is part of the {wiki:Tibia Tales}.
Jerom, northeast of Edron (near Avar Tar)
Jerom, northeast of Edron (near Avar Tar)

A welcome quest for anyone leaving the {wiki:Isle of Destiny}: it points you to five NPCs in Ankrahmun, Edron, Outlaw Camp, Thais and Venore, each with an easy quest and quick rewards. You earn 100 experience for each NPC you talk to (500 in total), and more rewards when you do their quests.
Ahmet, Ankrahmun (can be done in any order)
Ahmet, Ankrahmun (can be done in any order)

Three small missions on the island of Targuna. You help {npc:Lizzie} put an end to a lizard clan hiding in a temple, rid the island of Aragonia of pirates for {npc:Sterling} and find a buried treasure, and defeat the {creature:Herald of Fire} in the Crimson Court at {npc:Emiliana}'s request. You earn experience, platinum coins, an {item:Adventurer Backpack} and the {wiki:Reliable Ram|Reliable Ram} mount.
Mission *Burning heat*: give the {item:Bunch of Turnips} that {npc:Emiliana} hands you to the ram on the west side of Targuna.
If you lose the turnips, Emiliana sells you more for 1000 gold.

A short quest in the Edron Troll Cave, west of the city. Leave through the castle sewer, cross the cave to the grass area, go down to the troll cave and open the two boxes on the last floor to receive some {item:Brass Legs} and a {item:Garlic Necklace}.
Sewer in the southwest corner of Edron castle
Sewer in the southwest corner of Edron castle

A mini world change in which a large {wiki:Chakoya Iceberg|iceberg} runs aground on the north coast of {wiki:Tiquanda}, north of Port Hope, bringing with it a tribe of {wiki:Chakoyas}. It gives no reward of its own, but it is a good place to hunt Chakoyas and collect {item:Fireproof Horn|Fireproof Horns}, and it is one of the locations of the {wiki:Cartography 101 Quest}.

An archer got lost in the {wiki:Thais Troll Cave|Thais Troll Cave}, east of Thais, and died of poison. Go down three floors, cross the poison fields around the {creature:Slime|Slimes} spawn and use his body to receive a {item:Bow}, 5 {item:Poison Arrow|Poison Arrows}, a {item:Mana Potion} and a {item:Health Potion}.
Troll cave entrance east of Thais
Troll cave entrance east of Thais

Steal the small treasure of the greedy goblins of the {wiki:Edron Goblin Cave}, west of the city. Cross the cave from the Edron castle sewer, go down the goblin hill and open the two chests in the throne room to receive a {item:Steel Shield} and a {item:Silver Amulet}.
Sewer in the southwest corner of Edron castle
Sewer in the southwest corner of Edron castle
A short quest in {wiki:Shadowthorn}, the elves' refuge near Venore. Go down to the cellar of the elven fortress, reach the barrel marked on the map and open it to get a {item:Heaven Blossom}.

A descent into the {wiki:Ancient Temple|Ancient Temple}, beneath the north entrance of Thais, to the "Home of the dead Kingdom of Kormarak". After getting past poisonous gas, Minotaurs and a room full of {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} with a {creature:Demon Skeleton}, you find a corpse with a {item:Brass Armor}, a {item:Brass Helmet}, a {item:Hatchet} and 13 {item:Throwing Star|Throwing Stars}.

Sometimes a lumberjack, {npc:Chip}, shows up illegally cutting the royal trees in the fields north of Carlin and buys {item:Wood|pieces of wood}. Talk to him and then report him to {npc:Queen Eloise} to get the achievement Whistle-Blower.
30 minutes (plus the 5 min waits if you get caught)

A band of thieves stole a sacred casket from the nomads. {npc:Muhad}, the nomads' leader, asks you to sneak into the thieves' hideout, beneath Ankrahmun, and recover it. It is a stealth mission: you must not make noise or be seen. You earn 50 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, a {item:Jewel Case (Nomad)}, the scroll {item:The Sacred Casket (Book)} and 2 {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires}.

On some days, a group of nomads sets up camp at one of four possible locations in the Kha'labal desert, near Ankrahmun. Three of these camps have a chest you can open once per activation. Opening all three chests (on different days) gives you the achievement **Chest Robber**.
One of the 4 possible camps (northeast of the Shadow Tomb)
One of the 4 possible camps (northeast of the Shadow Tomb)

Any city guide ({wiki:Guide NPCs|Guide NPC}) can send you on the Pilgrimage of Ashes: a journey through the five holy places of Tibia, where you buy the five {wiki:Blessings|blessings} at a 1000 gold discount each. At the end, if you are below level 25, the guide gives you back 20 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.
Guide Luke, in Thais (any city guide works)
Guide Luke, in Thais (any city guide works)

Inside a mountain in the Femor Hills there is a two-floor goblin lair. At the bottom, next to the beer barrels, are the quest boxes with a {item:Power Ring} and a {item:Bronze Amulet}. A good quest for low levels.
Magic Carpet in the Femor Hills
Magic Carpet in the Femor Hills

To bless a wooden stake you need an ancient prayer spoken by ten priests, each in a different city. You buy a {item:Wooden Stake} from {npc:Gamon} in Thais and carry the stake from temple to temple across the mainland, receiving one line of the prayer in each. At the end you receive the {item:Blessed Wooden Stake} and, if you go to {npc:Chondur}, the achievement **Blessed!** and the possibility of blessing more stakes.
At the end of the quest, when you talk to Chondur in Meriana ({key:wooden stake}).
Blesses one of your own {item:Wooden Stake} per week (real time). You need the {wiki:Meriana Quest}.

{npc:Norman The Foreman}, foreman of the construction works in the swamp east of Venore, always needs an extra hand. He has three daily tasks — **Maintenance** (oiling machines), **Pathfinder** (delivering supplies) and **Sabotage** (killing corym rats) — that give experience and gold. If you do all three in under 20 hours you also get a bonus: 1000 XP and 1000 gp per day in total.
Norman The Foreman, central construction site east of Venore
Norman The Foreman, central construction site east of Venore
30–60 min (plus the time to get the Nomad Parchment)

{npc:Arito}, a shop owner in Ankrahmun, used to be a nomad and his name appears on a Nomads blacklist. You open the secret entrance to the Nomad Cave with a scimitar and water, talk to the chief {npc:Muhad} so that he forgives Arito, and return with the good news. You receive 50 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.
When you start the quest: talk to {npc:Arito} with a {item:Nomad Parchment} and open the secret entrance with a scimitar and water.
After the quest you can only go back into the cave (through the back entrance) to hunt Nomads if you agreed to help {npc:Muhad} in the {wiki:Nomads Land Quest|Nomads Land Quest}.
In step 3, when {npc:Muhad} asks if you want to help the tribe, answer {key:yes}.
The Nomads Land Quest requires you to have finished this quest.

The witch {npc:Wyda}, in the Green Claw Swamp near Venore, talks about the usefulness of a rare herb that grows next to dead trees. Cross the Venore Rotworm Cave and the swamp, kill a {creature:Giant Spider} and open the {item:Dead Tree} to get a {item:Blood Herb}, which you can keep as a valuable decoration or swap with Wyda for a {item:Witchesbroom}.

{npc:Emperor Kruzak} has cookies for you. Find the {item:Key 3800} in the secret passage of the emperor's quarters, in Kazordoon, open the small room of his bedroom to take the cookies and the {item:Key 3801}, and use this one in the barracks to get the {item:Key 3802}, which opens the {wiki:Dwacatra} prison and the {wiki:Mine Hub}.
Key 3800 chest (end of the west secret passage)
Key 3800 chest (end of the west secret passage)
With the {item:Key 3802}, which you take from the barracks chest at the end of the quest.
With the {item:Key 3802}, which you take from the barracks chest at the end of the quest.

Deep inside Thais' {wiki:Ancient Temple}, past the rotworms, the orcs and a room full of poison fields, there is a well that leads to a room guarded by three {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}. Take the key from a skeleton, go down the well, kill the ghouls and open the door to receive a {item:Garlic Necklace} and a {item:Club Ring}.

From time to time strange insectoids appear west of {wiki:Greenshore}, north of Thais. If nobody kills them, they eat the leaves and grass and leave an insectoid desert behind. Kill enough {creature:Insectoid Scout|Insectoid Scouts} to stop the invasion and let the land turn green again; while the invasion lasts you can kill them and add up Bestiary charm points.
10 minutes per round (plus the wait until the next round)

Monthly event in Darashia: {npc:Casper} gives you a {item:Shapechanger} that disguises you as a random creature, and you have to run to the right teleport before time runs out, over eight increasingly fast cycles. Those who reach the end get a {item:Shapeshifter Ring} and a {item:Reward Box}, and if the server wins enough rounds everyone gets 20% more respawn temporarily.

An orc shaman guards his treasure in a small orc outpost in the swamps east of Venore. Open the hidden hole with the shovel, go down into the {wiki:Venore Orc Cave|Venore Orc Cave}, kill the {creature:Orc Shaman} and his companions and open the box to receive a {item:Magic Light Wand}, an {item:Axe Ring} and a {item:Blank Rune}.
Small cave in the swamps east of Venore
Small cave in the swamps east of Venore

In the forests around Ab'Dendriel, {creature:White Deer} are hunted by wolves and poachers who want their antlers and hides, while the elves try to protect them. If players kill too many deer in a day, the next day {creature:Starving Wolf|Starving Wolves} appear instead of deer; capturing those wolves makes the deer come back. While there are deer you can loot {item:White Deer Antlers} and {item:White Deer Skin} and try to tame a White Deer as a mount ({wiki:Kingly Deer}).
While the {creature:White Deer} are not overhunted: use a {item:Golden Fir Cone} on a White Deer to try to tame it.
If there is overhunting, the deer only return after you capture the {creature:Starving Wolf|Starving Wolves}.

Every day there is a fight for control of the {wiki:Poacher Caves}, in {wiki:Ferngrims Gate}, north of the Green Claw Swamp: on one side the wild animals, on the other the {creature:Poacher|Poachers} who hunt them — and, when the hunters overdo it, vengeful wolf spirits appear. Depending on who is in control, the caves have different creatures, and it is the players' actions that decide who wins.

On certain days, the dry river of the {wiki:Zao Steppe} flows again and fills with fish. While it is active you can fish for {item:Sandfish|Sandfishes}, and the first one you catch gives you the achievement **Desert Fisher**.
Entrance to the Zao Steppe, east of the Farmine mountain
Entrance to the Zao Steppe, east of the Farmine mountain

The outlaws of the {wiki:Outlaw Camp} are going through hard times and their leader, {npc:Rottin Wood}, needs help: getting rabbit's foot "lucky charms", repairing the camp walls and ambushing merchants crossing the forest. You earn gold, experience, the achievements Merry Adventures and Bunny Slipped and, in the daily tasks, a chance to receive a {item:Time Ring} or a {item:Hunting Horn}.
Rottin Wood's daily tasks (Lucky Loop and Handyman)
After the missions: ask {npc:Rottin Wood} for them with {key:task} ({key:lucky charms} or {key:repairs}).
They give experience and gold; Lucky Loop also gives a chance of a {item:Time Ring} (9%) or a {item:Hunting Horn} (about 1%).

The shopkeeper {npc:Ahmet}, of Ankrahmun, was robbed and the thieves fled to the oasis north of the city. Find the bag with his belongings hidden behind a palm tree and return it to him in exchange for 100 {item:Brown Mushroom|Brown Mushrooms} and 100 {item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins}.

Also known as the Carlin Gems Quest. {npc:Padreia}, of the Carlin druid guild, had a vision: a plague is going to come out of the city sewers, spread by slimes. She gives you a vial of poison to pour into the water the slimes come from. If you do, you receive four small gems.
Event from 11 to 15 November (prizes until 30 November); 2–6 hours to light all the basins

Every year in November, {npc:Lucius} asks Lightbearers to keep 10 {item:Lightbringer's Basin|sacred basins} scattered around the world lit for 96 hours. You receive a {item:Magical Torch} in Yalahar and use it on each basin, facing the creatures of darkness that may appear. If the server succeeds, there are global bonuses and a rewards room in Kazordoon with backpacks full of rings, gems, Midnight Shards and achievements.
15–30 min (plus the time to hunt the Bast Skirts)

The cyclops smith {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops}, in Ab'Dendriel, will only work for you after you do him a favour: three {item:Bast Skirt|Bast Skirts} for his 'girlfriend'. From then on he turns armours, shields, helmets and weapons into rare metals for addons and quests, and {item:Soul Orb|Soul Orbs} into {item:Infernal Bolt|Infernal Bolts}.
Trades with A Sweaty Cyclops (rare metals and Infernal Bolts)
When you hand the 3 {item:Bast Skirt|Bast Skirts} to {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} ({key:bast skirt}, {key:yes}).
Variable (depends on the state of the lake; fish once every 20 h)

The {wiki:Lake Equivocolao}, north of Port Hope, is the only place where the rare {item:Shimmer Swimmer} lives, but the fish only appears when the lake is filthy. The server's players throw corpses into the lake; after 1000 corpses, the lake becomes dirty at the next server save and you can try to fish a Shimmer Swimmer. After 50 you get the achievement **Biodegradable**.
Lake Equivocolao, north of Port Hope
Lake Equivocolao, north of Port Hope
Annual event from 1 to 7 September (each phase lasts hours; rewards until 30 September)

Annual world quest: an ancestral weapon, {creature:Devovorga}, awakens beneath Vengoth and opens portals all over the continent to its five incarnations. The whole server has to cooperate to kill the incarnations at the same time, destroy the cocoon and finally Devovorga herself. If the world succeeds, it gets +50% health and mana regeneration and +15% experience on Extra Dimensional creatures until the end of September; those who contributed get access to a rewards room.

Also known as the Vocation Quest or Desert Quest. A team with one player of each vocation crosses the maze beneath the Jakundaf Desert to the vocation room, where each one places an item of their vocation on a pedestal. If everything is right, the team is teleported to the reward room: a {item:Golden Bag} with 25 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} for each participating vocation and a {item:Green Bag} with a {item:Protection Amulet}, {item:Ring of Healing}, {item:Magic Light Wand} and {item:Ankh}.
Loose Stone Pile in the middle of the Jakundaf Desert
Loose Stone Pile in the middle of the Jakundaf Desert
7-day event (one short task per day) + 7 days of bonus

Seasonal event (5 to 12 August) at the {wiki:Great Expedition Wharf}, near Fibula. Every day {npc:Proprietor Piers} gives a group task at the shipyard; completing it earns you Event Points and a vote for a bonus for your world. You trade the points for rubber ducks, the Captain outfit, the Landsailer mount and exploration gear.
Fibula Tunnel (path between Thais and Fibula)
When you trade **140 Event Points**, at any stage of the event.
Only during the event (5 to 12 August).
Depends on the Swamp Fever raids and on drop luck

During the {wiki:Swamp Fever|Swamp Fever} raids, {creature:Feverish Citizen|Feverish Citizens} roam the streets of Venore and drop six different pieces of cloth: collect all six to unlock the {wiki:Afflicted Outfits|Afflicted Outfits}. The addons (bell and plague doctor mask) come from the {item:Belongings of a Deceased}, which {npc:Ottokar} gives you in exchange for {item:Medicine Pouch|Medicine Pouches} from the {creature:Swamp Troll|Swamp Trolls}.

Alawar hid his treasure in a vault guarded by minotaurs and magic fields, beneath the island of Senja, north of Carlin. There are two routes: the short one, through Senja castle, gives 3 {item:White Pearl|White Pearls} and a {item:Broadsword}; the long one, through the Folda caves, gives all the rewards, including a {item:Dark Helmet} and three keys.
Depends on the server (handing in coal is quick; keeping the mines open requires hunting every day)

The mines beneath Kazordoon (Sunken Mines) are flooded and hide the ruins of a sunken dynasty. If the server's players hand in 202 pieces of {item:Coal} to {npc:Dronk}'s water pumps, the mines open the next day: you get access to a hunting ground of {creature:Deepling Scout|Deepling Scouts}, to the boss {creature:Groam} and to a steamship from Kazordoon to Thais and Robson's Isle.

From time to time, thieves rob the bank in Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel or Venore and the banker stops working. Find the thief hiding near the city, kill him, pick up the {item:Bag With Stolen Gold} and return it to the banker before Server Save. You receive 10 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} and the achievement **Honest Finder** (and **Goldhunter** after five bags).
Banker of the robbed city (e.g. Naji, Thais)
Banker of the robbed city (e.g. Naji, Thais)

To be accepted as an honorary barbarian in Svargrond you have to pass three trials from {npc:Sven}: drink mead without passing out, hug a bear and knock down a mammoth. You earn a {item:Mead Horn}, the achievements **Bearhugger** and **Honorary Barbarian**, and you can become a citizen of Svargrond, travel with {npc:Buddel}, fight in the Svargrond Arena and start The Ice Islands Quest.
When you pass the 3rd trial and become an honorary barbarian ({key:mammoth} to {npc:Sven}).
You need Premium. This is where the {wiki:Barbarian Arena Quest|Barbarian Arena Quest} is done.
When you become an honorary barbarian, at the end of the 3rd trial.
When you become an honorary barbarian, at the end of the 3rd trial.

Takes you to the {wiki:Barbarian Settlements|barbarian camps}, to Okolnir and to Krimhorn; for Tyrsung you also need to have started the mission *Nibelor 2: Ecological Terrorism* of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest}.
When you become an honorary barbarian: {npc:Sven} tells you about {npc:Iskan}, who has trouble with dogs.
{npc:Iskan}'s sled to Nibelor only takes you after this quest and the first mission of The Ice Islands Quest.
Event from 1 April to 1 May (free hunting)

Every year, from 1 April to 1 May, an ice bridge links Svargrond to the frozen island of {wiki:Chyllfroest}. The island is full of cold creatures and even the odd {creature:Yeti}, and it is the **only** way to tame the {wiki:Ursagrodon} mount.
Only while the ice bridge to {wiki:Chyllfroest} is open (1 April to 1 May).
It is the only way to tame an Ursagrodon: look for the skeleton trapped in the ice, inside the island's mountain.

In the elven camp of {wiki:Shadowthorn|Shadowthorn}, in the swamps southeast of Venore, a large tower guarded by elves rises up. Reach the tower from above or below the camp, climb the five floors fighting {creature:Elf Scout|Elf Scouts} and {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}, and open the two boxes at the top to take a {item:Bow}, arrows, sapphires and potions.

A friend of Muriel's tried to escape from the Plains of Havoc, but did not make it out alive. His body is half-hidden by a tree, west of the camp of cyclopes, orcs and minotaurs. Open it to receive an {item:Iron Helmet}, a {item:Sudden Death Rune}, a {item:Leather Armor}, the book {item:Porgol's Strange Behaviour (Book)|Porgol's Strange Behaviour}, some {item:Worn Leather Boots} and a {item:Longsword}.
Body next to the tree, Plains of Havoc
Body next to the tree, Plains of Havoc

Mini world change in Tiquanda: {creature:Hunter|Hunters} and {wiki:Dworcs|Dworcs} fight over some sacred grounds in the jungle. Depending on the day, you find at the site a {wiki:Hunter Camp|Hunter Camp} with Hunters and Poachers, or a {wiki:Dworc Camp|Dworc Camp} dominated by Dworcs, and perhaps the boss of the winning clan: {creature:Arthom the Hunter} or {creature:Oodok Witchmaster}.

Go down through the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, north of Thais, cross poison fields and the minotaur city of Mintwallin to a room with Cyclops. Pull the switch (you get trapped with the cyclopes), take the reward and leave through a hole. You receive a {item:Small Diamond}, two {item:Strong Health Potion|Strong Health Potions}, a {item:Hatchet}, a {item:Chain Helmet} and a {item:Chain Armor}.

{npc:Amanda}, priestess of the Edron temple, needs holy water from the {wiki:White Raven Monastery} to purify the unholy cemetery north of the city. Fetch the water from {npc:Costello} on the Isle of the Kings, pour it on the 15 graves in the cemetery and receive a package with 5 Health Potions and 5 Mana Potions.

The astronomer {npc:Spectulus}, of Edron, wants to build a magical device capable of sailing the 'sea of light'. You recover the plans from a beggar who used to be a scientist, pick up a rare crystal in the Lost Mines and use that crystal to enter the lair of {creature:The Collector}, in Vega, from where you bring back the Mirror Crystal. You earn experience, a {item:Yellow Gem} and 10 {item:Small Diamond|Small Diamonds}.
Spectulus, top of the central tower of the Noodles Academy (Edron)
Spectulus, top of the central tower of the Noodles Academy (Edron)
After you complete the quest, with {npc:Spectulus}.

A member of the Explorer Society got lost while investigating the amazon camp north of Venore. This page covers two quests very close together: at Witch Hill, two boxes hold the {item:Skull of Ratha}, a {item:White Pearl}, a {item:Wolf Tooth Chain} and a {item:Dwarven Ring}; in the cellar of the witches' house, a chest holds 100 gp, a {item:Crystal Necklace} and 2 {item:Black Pearl|Black Pearls}. The only difficulty is defeating the guards.
Witch Hill, amazon camp (north of Venore)
Witch Hill, amazon camp (north of Venore)
30–60 min per day; minimum 25 days for the full outfit

The gnomes of {wiki:The Spike|The Spike} need help fighting the enemies around their base. Depending on your level you do 4 daily tasks in the Upper, Middle or Lower Spike; each gives experience and 1 fame point. With the fame you accumulate you buy the {wiki:Cave Explorer Outfits|Cave Explorer Outfits} and their addons.
North teleport next to Xelvar (Kazordoon temple)
North teleport next to Xelvar (Kazordoon temple)
Bought from {npc:Gnommander} with fame points from the tasks ({key:reward}, {key:worthy}): you need 100 fame for the full outfit.
They also cost 1,000 gp (outfit), 2,000 gp (1st addon) and 3,000 gp (2nd addon).

A man managed to trap two cyclopes in the cellar of the Thais lighthouse and forced them to forge weapons. With the help of a partner, you activate a pressure plate and a lever to open the teleport to the secret room and open the chests with the {item:Dark Shield} and the {item:Battle Hammer}.
~4 hours (10 missions; can be done in stages)

{npc:Kevin} runs the Tibia Postal Service and only accepts postmen who prove their worth. You do 10 mail missions all over Tibia, rising from Assistant Postman to Arch Postman. You get cheaper letters and parcels, boat discounts, the {item:Post Officer's Hat}, the {item:Post Horn}, access to the royal mailboxes and the achievement **Archpostman**.
Kevin's post offices, between Thais and Kazordoon
Kevin's post offices, between Thais and Kazordoon
When you reach **Assistant Postman** (end of mission 2).
When you reach **Grand Postman** (end of mission 6).
When you reach **Arch Postman** (end of mission 10).
Shortcut in mission 6 of The Thieves Guild Quest
With the **Arch Postman** rank and the {item:Post Officer's Hat} on your head, you receive the key for mission 6 (Fishnapping) without bribes.
The wiki mentions a 6k discount on that quest.

Someone died at the top of a remote mountain in {wiki:Chyllfroest} carrying something very valuable to survive the cold. Climb to the top of the mountain, use the pile of bones and you receive a {item:Tinder Box}. It is only possible between 1 April and 1 May, when the island is accessible, and you can repeat it every 20 hours.
50 min – 1h30 (less if you already have the keys)

Cross the {wiki:Hellgate}, beneath Ab'Dendriel, to the pyramid of {wiki:Draconia}. Floor by floor you find keys 3001 to 3008, solve small puzzles and, with the help of at least one companion, reach the chests with the {item:Ice Rapier}, {item:Serpent Sword}, {item:Stone Skin Amulet} and {item:Energy Ring}.
East of Port Hope, in the {wiki:Tiquanda} jungle, there is a poachers' camp. The box there, on the surface, holds 2 {item:Elephant Tusk|Elephant Tusks}.
30 min–2 hours per difficulty (max. 10 min per fight)

In the {wiki:Svargrond Arena|Svargrond arena} you face 10 fighters in a row on your own, in three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. Pay the fee to {npc:Halvar}, win the 10 fights of each level and choose one of five rewards (three weapons, a gift or a backpack), plus a bronze, silver or gold goblet with your name. Finishing Warlord gives the achievement **Warlord of Svargrond**.
At least 6 days (one request at a time, with 20 hours of sleep between requests)

Annual event in May: the {npc:Demon Mother}, in the Jakundaf Desert, hands you a baby demon ({item:Demon Infant}) to look after. You have to fulfil 6 random requests from the baby (eating, kissing creatures, visiting places...) and return it happy. You get a baby demon doll, achievements and, if your world returns enough babies, a 50% experience bonus.

A group of elite cyclops warriors lost their valuable hammer during a war against the Minotaurs. Go down into the Minotaur caves west of Kazordoon and find the chest hidden among some beds to receive an {item:Iron Hammer}.
Pile of loose stones west of Kazordoon
Pile of loose stones west of Kazordoon

A travelling family was attacked and their belongings were hidden by trolls and minotaurs in {wiki:Dusalk's Troll Clan Cave|Dusalk's troll clan cave}, east of the Dwarf Bridge. Go down into the cave, get past the minotaurs and open the quest boxes to recover a {item:Longsword}, a {item:Wedding Ring} and other objects.
Troll cave, east of the Dwarf Bridge
Troll cave, east of the Dwarf Bridge

The orc shamans keep magical equipment in their hideout, the {wiki:Edron Orc Cave|Edron Orc Cave}. Go down two floors of the cave and find the skeleton, guarded by {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans}, where 3 {item:Blank Rune|Blank Runes} are.
Edron Orc Cave entrance (southwest of the castle)
Edron Orc Cave entrance (southwest of the castle)

It is said that a group of {creature:Frost Giant|Frost Giants} tortured a prisoner on the island of {wiki:Tyrsung} and stole his money. Cross the giants' territory to their room and take what is left of the prisoner from a barrel: a {item:Skeleton Decoration}, 89 gp and a {item:Shard}.

One-day mini world change in the Tiquanda jungle: the Ape God has frightened the elephants, and in a small clearing south of Banuta {creature:Terrified Elephant|Terrified Elephants} appear. They drop {item:Elephant Tusk|Elephant Tusks} more often than normal elephants, and killing 5 gives the achievement **Trail of the Ape God**.
Clearing in the Tiquanda jungle, south of Banuta
Clearing in the Tiquanda jungle, south of Banuta

{creature:Tainted Soul|Tainted Souls} roam the Tainted Caves, in the Green Claw Swamp near Venore. With a {item:Sacred Antler Talisman} that you craft yourself, you free 100 souls and earn the right to face the witch {creature:Ekatrix}. The quest resets every time you enter the boss room.
After freeing 100 souls with the {item:Sacred Antler Talisman}, enter the {item:Mystic Flame} on the 4th floor of the {wiki:Tainted Caves}.
Once every 20 hours; the quest resets every time you enter the boss room.
1–2 hours (freeing) + as long as you like putting out fires

In Shadowthorn, the elves who refused to worship the bog god set fire to the village and were locked up in three underground prisons. If you kill the guards and all the elves, the prisons open and, the next day, Shadowthorn is on fire. You put out the fires with swamp water from the bog god's temple: 500 fires give the achievement **Firefighter** and, with luck, a Thornfire Wolf appears that you can turn into the {item:Crystal Wolf (Mount)|Crystal Wolf} mount.
Pyro Peter, in Venore (reports the state of Shadowthorn)
Pyro Peter, in Venore (reports the state of Shadowthorn)

With Shadowthorn on fire, each fire you put out has a small chance of making a {creature:Thornfire Wolf} appear: lure it to the {item:Bog Water} at the bog god's temple to turn it into a {creature:Crystal Wolf} and tame it with the {item:Diapason}.

A chest quest underground in Thais: from the {wiki:Ancient Temple|Ancient Temple}, go down the Mintwallin path, cross poison fields and minotaurs and use a {item:Pick} in an underground park to reach a box with 10 {item:Throwing Star|Throwing Stars}.

The villains of the Elvenbane fortress, west of Ab'Dendriel, have a crystal ball they use to spy on the elves' war talks. {npc:Eroth} gives you a {item:Mirror} to reflect the ball's power and destroy it. You climb to the top of the central Elvenbane tower, use the mirror on the {item:Scrying Ball} and receive 10 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} and an {item:Elven Amulet}.

A quest from the {wiki:Tibia Tales}: the caliph {npc:Kazzan} of Darashia wants at least one of the Djinn races on his side. You learn the Djinn greeting word from {npc:Melchior} and take a peace proposal to the Marid and/or the Efreet. At the end you receive 20 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.

An {creature:Elf Arcanist} guards a treasure at the top of the central tower of the fortified Elvenbane castle, near Ab'Dendriel. Cross the cellar full of orcs and minotaurs, climb the tower past poison fields, a {creature:Dragon} and mages, and defeat the final team to open two chests and two drawers with a {item:Morning Star}, a {item:Dwarven Shield}, a {item:Spellbook} and more.

{npc:Rafzan}, a "poor and honest" goblin merchant in the Venore swamp, needs help with 6 small tasks: spreading advertising, making perfume for the ratmen, "recruiting" guards, annoying and sabotaging the ratmen and killing Marsh Stalkers. Each task gives experience and gold (5200 exp and 1100 gp in total) and can be repeated every 20 hours. After 500 tasks you get the achievement **Task Manager**.

Small treasure quest in {wiki:Inukaya|Inukaya}, the Chakoya camp near Svargrond. Travel by dog sled from Nibelor, enter an igloo in the village and search a barrel to find a fur bag with a {item:Shard}, 48 gold and 3 {item:Rainbow Trout|Rainbow Trouts}.

Beneath the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, north of Thais, cross the tunnels full of orcs, lower the drawbridge and get past the Bonelords to a hidden hole. Down there, a box holds a {item:Life Ring} and a {item:Dragon Necklace}.

At the bottom of the {wiki:Desert Dungeon}, in the Jakundaf desert, there is a box guarded by a {creature:Fire Devil} with a bag containing a {item:Power Ring}, a {item:Panpipes} and 2 {item:Small Amethyst|Small Amethysts}. Go down to the bottom of the dungeon and climb back up by another path to the locked door where the treasure is.

A small quest from the {wiki:Tibia Tales} in Edron: {npc:Spectulus} and {npc:Sinclair} want to study ghosts. You measure the energy of graves in the Edron cemetery with a magical device and then capture the essence of a {creature:Ghost} in a spirit cage. You earn 2 × 500 experience points and the achievement **Guinea Pig**, and unlock the {wiki:Spirithunters Quest}.
After handing the full cage to {npc:Sinclair}: talk to him again to start.

A band of minotaurs hides objects stolen from the dwarves in their tower west of Kazordoon. Enter through the secret hideout, climb the {wiki:Minotaur Tower|Minotaur Tower} fighting Minotaur Guards, Archers and Mages, and collect a {item:Steel Helmet}, two piles of coins and the scroll {item:The Fox Is Out (Book)|The Fox Is Out}.
Loose Stone Pile behind the Plum Tree
Loose Stone Pile behind the Plum Tree

The foreman {npc:Budrik} was robbed by the gang of {creature:The Horned Fox}: they took his 600-year-old miner's helmet that belonged to his father and grandfather. Recover it in a minotaur tower near the Dwarf Mines and Budrik gives you his spare helmet, a {item:Mining Helmet}. It also unlocks the Turmoil of War task.
When you return the helmet to {npc:Budrik}: you can now start this task of the {wiki:Killing in the Name of... Quest}.

A short quest in the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp}, near Venore. Go down a hole in the north of the swamp to the {creature:Witch|Witches}' cave and open the two reward boxes to receive a {item:Voodoo Doll (King)} and a {item:Magic Light Wand}.
Hole in the north of the Green Claw Swamp
Hole in the north of the Green Claw Swamp
45–90 min (mostly the walk through the jungle)

A pirate forgot his treasure in a cave behind a waterfall, near the lair of the treacherous {creature:Hydra|Hydras}, in Tiquanda. Cross the jungle to the hidden hole near {npc:The Blind Prophet}, climb through the cave, jump off the waterfall and open the chest to receive the {item:Pirate Backpack}, the {item:Pirate Hat} and the {item:Dwarven Ring}.
Hidden hole near The Blind Prophet
Hidden hole near The Blind Prophet
Several hours (mostly collecting ingredients); only in August

The cook {npc:Jean Pierre}, who lives west of the Blue Djinn Fortress, near Ankrahmun, takes you on as an apprentice. For each dish you bring him a list of ingredients and he cooks it with you: first 10 dishes of the course, then the "menu" with the winning dishes of the 2010 contest and the {item:Zaoan Sauce}. You keep all the dishes (with special effects), get the achievement **Culinary Master** and the books {item:Jean Pierre's Cookbook I} and {item:Jean Pierre's Cookbook II}.
Jean Pierre, west of the Blue Djinn Fortress (1 floor above ground)
Jean Pierre, west of the Blue Djinn Fortress (1 floor above ground)

In a hidden cave beneath {wiki:Mt. Sternum}, east of Thais, the guardian {npc:Skjaar} will only hand over the crypt key to those who prove they knew his master, the mage Dago. Pay 1000 gp, answer the quiz, pass the level 35 door and open the chests to receive a {item:Noble Armor} and a {item:Crown Helmet}.
5–10 minutes (plus the time to clear the creatures)
Cross several floors of Edron's {wiki:Hero Cave}, full of heroes, monks, priestesses and dragons, to the last floor, where a box holds a {item:Silver Rune Emblem (Ultimate Healing)}.
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron

The Edron orcs guard their equipment well in the underground hideout. Go down floor by floor through the {wiki:Edron Orc Cave|Edron Orc Cave}, face many {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} and open the box at the end of the last room to receive a {item:Barbarian Axe} and a {item:Scimitar}.

The Edron orcs keep a small treasure in their cave. Go down four floors of the Edron Orc Cave, face groups of {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} and {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders} and open the box at the end of the last floor to receive 3 {item:White Pearl|White Pearls} and 175 gp.
Edron Orc Cave entrance, southwest of the castle
Edron Orc Cave entrance, southwest of the castle
Depends on your progress in the Dreamer's Challenge Quest

The {wiki:Brotherhood Outfits|Brotherhood Outfits} (Brotherhood of Bones) are obtained by using three brotherhood documents that you earn in the missions of the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest|Dreamer's Challenge Quest}, in the Plains of Havoc. Each document unlocks a part of the outfit; the quest also gives the achievement **Skull and Bones**.
Dreamer's Challenge Quest entrance (Plains of Havoc)
Dreamer's Challenge Quest entrance (Plains of Havoc)

A warrior was killed by a {creature:Giant Spider} deep in the Edron Orc Cave. Go down the cave's many floors, get past the orcs and the shamans and find his body in the spider pit, with a {item:Dark Armor} inside.
Edron Orc Cave entrance, southwest of the castle
Edron Orc Cave entrance, southwest of the castle

When the river south of the {wiki:Outlaw Camp} overflows, a small new island becomes accessible with a spawn of 11 {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals}. Kill 50 of them in the dungeon to get the achievement **Down the Drain**.
New island south of the Outlaw Camp
New island south of the Outlaw Camp
1–2 hours (plus the time to collect Demonic Essences for the ranks)

Beneath the Plains of Havoc lies the path to the {wiki:Dream Realm}. You pass a series of puzzles (colours, levers, tic-tac-toe and the dream room) and choose to join the {wiki:Nightmare Knights|Nightmare Knights} or the {wiki:Brotherhood of Bones}. You earn achievements, teleports from the Knightwatch Tower to several cities, your faction's outfits and, by ranking up with Demonic Essences, a {item:Nightmare Shield} or {item:Necromancer Shield}.
Ruined building in the Plains of Havoc
Ruined building in the Plains of Havoc
When you complete the challenges; then you return through the teleport on the 2nd floor of the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower} (rank Novice/Maggot).
The teleport only works with Premium and an {item:Orichalcum Pearl} on you.
Nightmare Knights or Brotherhood of Bones faction
When you enter the faction teleport and say {key:join} to {npc:The Dream Master} or {npc:The Bone Master}; you rank up with {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences} (500, +1000, +1500).
Knightwatch Tower teleports to Thais, Carlin and the Dream Realm (2nd floor)
**Novice** (Nightmare Knights) or **Maggot** (Brotherhood) rank, when you join the faction.
You need Premium and an {item:Orichalcum Pearl} on you.
Knightwatch Tower teleports to Kazordoon, Ab'Dendriel and Fibula (3rd floor)
You need Premium and an {item:Orichalcum Pearl} on you.
Knightwatch Tower teleports to Darashia, Ankrahmun and Mintwallin (4th floor)
**Lord Protector** or **Dread Lord** rank (another 1500 {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences}).
You need Premium and an {item:Orichalcum Pearl} on you.
Nightmare or Brotherhood outfits and their addons

Outfit with the {item:Document of the Follower} (Novice/Maggot); first addon with the {item:Document of the Officer} (Initiate/Hyaena); second addon with the {item:Document of the Leader} (Dreamer/Death Dealer).
Creating the outfit documents in the Dream Realm
One {item:Small Diamond} per document, at the altars in the officers' quarters.

In the centre of {wiki:Krimhorn}, near the largest settlement of the {wiki:Raider Camp}, there is a chest with fish and some money. Travel with {npc:Buddel}, cross the barbarian camp and open the chest to receive 3 {item:Green Perch|Green Perches}, 3 {item:Rainbow Trout|Rainbow Trouts} and 5 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.

Cyclopes are great smiths and use a giant hammer in one of their camps. In the cyclops and minotaur camp in the Plains of Havoc, beneath the north structure, a quest box holds the {item:Giant Smithhammer}, a {item:Talon} and 100 gp — but the room is full of monsters.
Stairs in the north structure of the camp (Plains of Havoc)
Stairs in the north structure of the camp (Plains of Havoc)

Some vocations have special places that only they can enter, and druids are no exception. Cross the {wiki:Magic Forcefield} in the Plains of Havoc to reach the {wiki:Isle of the Mists} and collect 2 {item:Small Emerald|Small Emeralds} and a {item:Book} from the box and the drawer on the ground floor.
Magic Forcefield in the Plains of Havoc
Magic Forcefield in the Plains of Havoc
Depends on the Demonic Essences (from hours to weeks)

Members of the {wiki:Nightmare Knights|Nightmare Knights} can use the Nightmare outfit. Earn it by advancing through the missions of the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest|Dreamer's Challenge Quest} and using the documents of each rank: {item:Document of the Follower} (outfit), {item:Document of the Officer} (shield/spear) and {item:Document of the Leader} (helmet).
15–30 min (plus the trips until the boat is diverted)

A ghost ship haunts the waters between Venore and Darashia. Travel by boat on that route until you are hijacked by the {wiki:Ghostship}, cross over to the southern boat, kill the undead in the hold and open the coffin to receive a {item:Plate Armor}. You leave through a magic portal that drops you at the Darashia port.

The orc shamans use poisoned equipment in their rituals. You go down through the Edron Orc Cave, cross four floors full of orcs and {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and open the chest at the bottom, which has a backpack with 2 {item:Poison Dagger|Poison Daggers} and 30 {item:Poison Arrow|Poison Arrows}.
Edron Orc Cave entrance, southwest of the castle
Edron Orc Cave entrance, southwest of the castle

A Nightmare Knight, on his way to the Knightwatch Tower, fell into a hole in the Plains of Havoc and was killed by a {creature:Giant Spider}. In the spider's lair you find his remains: 5 {item:Power Bolt|Power Bolts}, 12 {item:Burst Arrow|Burst Arrows}, a {item:Two Handed Sword} and the book {item:The Dreammaster (Book)}, plus {item:Throwing Star|Throwing Stars} and a {item:Talon} that respawn every day.
Hole south of the Plains of Havoc temple
Hole south of the Plains of Havoc temple

In a cave beneath the {wiki:Greenclaw Swamp|Greenclaw Swamp} there is a coffin guarded by mummies. Go down the cave, kill three {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, open a hole with the pick and face up to five {creature:Mummy|Mummies} in a small room to get a {item:Silver Brooch}, 2 {item:Small Ruby|Small Rubies} and 3 {item:Small Diamond|Small Diamonds}.
Cave entrance in the Greenclaw Swamp
Cave entrance in the Greenclaw Swamp

At the bottom of {wiki:Mintwallin}, the minotaur city, there is a pit guarded by dragons. Go down there and search the fire field north of the room to find a {item:Small Ruby}. It is a daily respawn: only one character can take it per day.
Stairs to the Mintwallin throne room
Stairs to the Mintwallin throne room

A warrior ventured too deep into the earth. Go down the small cave east of {wiki:Mount Sternum}, near the {wiki:Triangle Tower}, open holes with the pick and cross rooms full of {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} to a cave surrounded by lava, where the {item:Spike Sword} is inside a body hidden behind a pillar.
Small cave east of Mount Sternum
Small cave east of Mount Sternum

A not at all complicated but dangerous quest: go down the many floors of the {wiki:Minotaur Pyramid|Minotaur Pyramid}, northeast of Darashia, fighting your way through minotaurs of every kind. At the bottom, after killing a {creature:Mummy}, you open two coffins with a {item:Stealth Ring} and a {item:Protection Amulet}.

It is said that the dragons of the Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs guard a lot of treasure. Kill 50 {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and/or {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and then look for a {item:Hoard of Dragon Gold} to get a random reward. The task can be repeated right away and, after 10 times, you get the achievement **Hoard of the Dragon**.
1–2 hours for the 4 tasks (repeatable every 20 hours)

In the depths of {wiki:Hellgate}, beneath Ab'Dendriel, lives a small group of elves atoning for the sins of their ancestors. {npc:Ashari} has four daily tasks: watering the garden, sterilising diseased mushrooms, collecting flames from fire elementals and growing wild magic for the shaman. Each task gives experience and, if you do all four on the same day, you get a bonus (2000 XP and, rarely, a {item:Pannier Backpack}).
When you receive the daily bonus for the first time (all four tasks on the same day; {key:bonus} to {npc:Ashari}).
It is right next to Ashari, to the east, and goes past the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}. You can only use it 5 times per character, with no way to get uses back.

Go down a hole in {wiki:Shadowthorn}, the elven city near Venore, and clear a large room full of elves, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and a {creature:Demon Skeleton}. At the far north of the room, three quest boxes give you a {item:Time Ring}, an {item:Elven Amulet} and a {item:Crystal Ball}.

A masked man stole the day's takings from {npc:Iriana}, in Yalahar, and fled over the rooftops. Chase him from bridge to bridge (always choosing the right side of each bridge) to {npc:Jimmy}'s hideout, steal a box of food for him from the cellar of {npc:Pugwah}'s tavern and return the chest to Iriana. The reward is 10 {item:Heaven Blossom|Heaven Blossoms}. It is part of the {wiki:Tibia Tales}.

On Treasure Island, near Liberty Bay, you can use {item:Treasure Map (Pirate)|Pirate Treasure Maps} to dig up hidden holes that lead to underground caves full of undead and crabs. There is no reward or known quest: it is an exploration of the island's caves.
Captain Waverider, southeast of Liberty Bay
Captain Waverider, southeast of Liberty Bay
When you dig one of the spots on the island with a {item:Treasure Map (Pirate)|Pirate Treasure Map} in your backpack.
It is not permanent: each hole you open uses up one Pirate Treasure Map.

Three magic users are plotting in a tower full of undead in the desert. Climb the {wiki:Triangle Tower} floor by floor, past Skeletons, Ghouls, Demon Skeletons and Stalkers, and open the box at the top to receive a {item:Garlic Necklace}, a {item:Dwarven Ring} and two {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires}.

Help the tribe of Zao cavemen prepare for their great hunt. You recover the first leader's skull, show him the world from the highest points of 11 cities, dance for the god Krunus, make offerings to Pandor and Fasuon and find beer for the feast. You receive a {item:Tome of Knowledge}, a {item:Tribal Crest} (exchangeable for an addon), experience and the achievement **Talented Dancer**.
Lazaran, on the mountain between Farmine and the Zao plains
Lazaran, on the mountain between Farmine and the Zao plains
An addon of the Warmaster Outfits
At the end of the quest: take the {item:Tribal Crest} that {npc:Lazaran} gives you to {npc:Cael} and say {key:tribal crest}.

A small treasure hidden in the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}, on the island of Svargrond. Follow the path through the mines to a room with a barrel: inside is a fur bag with a {item:Berserk Potion}, 82 gp and a {item:Waterskin} of {item:Mead}.

One of Tibia's oldest quests: cross the maze beneath Thais' {wiki:Ancient Temple|Ancient Temple} to the underground minotaur city of {wiki:Mintwallin|Mintwallin}. With the help of at least one friend you open a grate, get past a dragon and reach the treasure room with the {item:Devil Helmet}, a {item:Halberd} and 4 {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires}.

A garrison of dwarves guards a treasure in a circular room deep in the mines west of Kazordoon. Go down five floors full of dwarves, pass the level 32 door and fight your way to the bottom of the circular room to receive a {item:Dwarven Axe} and a {item:War Hammer}.

The dwarves hid a shiny helmet deep in their mines, guarded by giant spiders. Go down through the {wiki:Dwarf Mines} (from Kazordoon) or through the Undead Cave of {wiki:Mount Sternum} (from Thais), pass the level 35 door and take the {item:Crusader Helmet} from a skeleton at the bottom of the tunnel.
Pick 'N Shovel Mine entrance, west of Kazordoon
Pick 'N Shovel Mine entrance, west of Kazordoon
1–2 hours (depends on your luck with the rare orc)

{npc:Sam}, the blacksmith of Thais, lost his old adventurer's backpack in an orc attack at Ulderek's Rock. Find it on a rare orc in the Orc Fortress, return it to Sam and he sends you to his friend {npc:Kroox}, in Kazordoon, who lets you fetch a {item:Dwarven Armor} from the dwarven mines.

At the bottom of the {wiki:Mount Sternum Undead Cave|Mount Sternum Undead Cave}, near Thais, a {creature:Dwarf Geomancer} and his guards protect a chest. Go down several floors, pass the {wiki:Graveyard of the Doomed|Graveyard of the Doomed} and the undead, and open the quest box to receive a {item:Small Sapphire}, a {item:Small Diamond} and a {item:Dwarven Ring}.
Stairs in the middle of Mount Sternum
Stairs in the middle of Mount Sternum

It seems a poacher managed to get into the {wiki:Formorgar Mines} but did not make it out alive. Follow the path from Svargrond to the mines, go down the stairs and open the chest in the corner to receive a {item:Lion Trophy}, a {item:Shard} and 2 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.
Stairs at the end of the path to the Formorgar Mines
Stairs at the end of the path to the Formorgar Mines

On the island of the monks of the White Raven Monastery, a brother disappeared in the Ghostlands. First you find the fisherman {npc:Dalbrect}'s {item:Family Brooch} in the Ghostlands, and from then on he takes you to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings}. Then the abbot {npc:Costello} asks you to investigate the disappearance of brother Fugio: you recover the {item:Monk's Diary} and receive a {item:Blessed Ankh}.
Hole beneath the wall to the Ghostlands (west of Carlin)
Hole beneath the wall to the Ghostlands (west of Carlin)
{npc:Dalbrect}'s boat to the Isle of the Kings
Mission 1: when you hand the {item:Family Brooch} to Dalbrect ({key:brooch}).
10 gp per trip ({key:passage}). If you enter the restricted area on the 3rd floor of the monastery and do not pay the fine to {npc:Costello}, Dalbrect stops taking you.
Protected doors of the Isle of the Kings catacombs
Mission 2 (*The Investigation*): when you talk to {npc:Costello} about {key:Fugio}.
Requires mission 1 to be completed (access to the Isle of the Kings, for the {item:Spectral Cloth}).
Requires this quest to be completed (access to the Isle of the Kings).
You need mission 1 (to reach the Isle of the Kings): it is a requirement on the AVIN branch; on the CGB branch you can do it before or during mission 6.

The Edron orcs have learned to breed {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} and are becoming a serious threat. {npc:Daniel Steelsoul} sends you to the {wiki:Edron Orc Cave|Edron Orc Cave} to destroy the 4 {item:Spider Egg|spider eggs}, on a mission he clearly thinks is suicidal. If you come back alive, you receive a {item:Terra Amulet}.

{npc:Rabaz}, in Farmine, has developed a great interest in plants and is writing a botany almanac about Zao. Take the {item:Botany Almanach}, collect samples of two rare plants, the {item:Giant Dreadcoil} and the {item:Giant Verminous}, with an {item:Obsidian Knife} and come back to receive the {item:Sedge Hat}, 1,000 gp and 3,000 experience. It is part of the {wiki:Tibia Tales}.
The {item:Sedge Hat} you receive at the end is needed for the Sedge Hat addon.

An adventurer who died in Helheim, near Svargrond, left some useful items behind. Go down three floors of the Helheim dungeon, full of undead, and look for his pile of bones to get a {item:Berserk Potion}, 2 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, a {item:Shard} and 3 {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences}.

The {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons} of {wiki:Okolnir|Okolnir} guard a small treasure in their lair. Go down the island's holes, kill the dragons and hatchlings along the way and survive the last room, with five Frost Dragons, to open the chest with a {item:Shard}, a {item:Bullseye Potion} and 10 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.

A Tibia Tale in the {wiki:Corym Mines|Corym Mines}, beneath the Venore Corym cave. The foreman {npc:Corym Ratter} wants to know why production is falling, but the workers are preparing a revolt: you forge a key, free the imprisoned coryms and gather {item:Rare Earth} for their weapons. You receive 2 {item:Gold Nugget|Gold Nuggets} and three small gems, but a surprise awaits you on the way out: the miniboss {creature:Cave Spider}.
