Corym Ratter, at the entrance to the Corym Mines
Corym Ratter, at the entrance to the Corym Mines
At the start of the quest: {npc:Corym Ratter} opens the mine for you ({key:help}, {key:yes}) and {npc:Corym Servant} gives you access to the floor below.
Part of the Corym Mines from the mission *The Curse Spreads* (Grimvale Quest)
You need access to the inside of the Corym Mines that this quest gives (you can start it right there).
Depends on collecting items (several days); 1–2 hours for the crossbow

{npc:Elane}, leader of the paladins' guild in Thais, gives the addons of the {wiki:Hunter Outfits|Hunter Outfit}. For the Hooded Cloak (male) or Winged Tiara (female) you recover her crossbow from the hidden cult in Liberty Bay and hand over leather, enchanted wings and three pieces of steel. For the Sniper Gloves you just hand over a pair of {item:Sniper Gloves}. The quest also gives the achievement **Hunting with Style**.

{npc:Jorge}, in the Adventurers' Guild, is a hunter and artist who wants to study the essence of raid monsters. Bring him {item:Silver Raid Token|Silver Raid Tokens}, which drop from raid creatures, and he swaps every 20 tokens for a replica of a rare souvenir from the Thais museum.
Swapping {item:Silver Raid Token|Silver Raid Tokens} with {npc:Jorge}
After agreeing to help Jorge ({key:help}, {key:yes}); ask for the list with {key:souvenir}.
Each replica of a souvenir from the Thais museum costs 20 Silver Raid Tokens.

Under the {wiki:Ancient Temple} of Thais, two {creature:Dragon|Dragons} guard their treasure on an island surrounded by lava. Cross the floors full of orcs, kill the dragons, put out the fire covering a hole and use it to receive 6 {item:Small Ruby|Small Rubies}.
On a small island in {wiki:Drefia} there is a chest with a pirate captain's savings. Cross Drefia, walk to the island and open the chest to receive a {item:Small Sapphire}, 50 gp and two books.
1 week (one mission per day, 30–60 min each)

{npc:Rashid}, the travelling merchant, is looking for experienced traders to buy goods from. To prove you are worthy, you do one task per day for a whole week, from Monday to Sunday, in different cities. At the end you can sell him items on any day and you get the achievement Recognised Trader.
On Sunday, in Carlin, after all the week's tasks: {npc:Rashid} declares you a Recognised Trader.
From now on you can sell him items on any day.

{npc:Tereban}, in Edron, wants to give special presents to his four children (a knight, a sorcerer, a druid and a paladin), who share the same birthday. The craftsmen need eight rare components hidden in dungeons all over the continent. Find them all and hand them to Tereban to receive 28,000 experience, 8,000 gp and the {item:Old Cape}.
Tereban, Mirabell's tavern (above the Edron depot)
Tereban, Mirabell's tavern (above the Edron depot)
The {item:Old Cape} you receive at the end is the item required for this addon.

A group of explorers tried to reach Demona and died along the way. Cross the caves from Northport, open the entrance to the Maze of Lost Souls with a hidden lever and follow the safe path to the final room, at the gates of Demona. There you find a {item:Griffin Shield}, a {item:Dwarven Axe} and an {item:Obsidian Lance}.

Investigate the myth of the fearsome Hugo across four cities, climb the Paradox Tower near Kazordoon and face the questions of the mad {npc:Riddler}. After being thrown into Hellgate, you find out your secret 'mathemagics' number from {npc:A Prisoner} in Mintwallin and return to the Riddler to enter the treasure room, where you take up to two of four rewards.
Oldrak, in the temple of the Plains of Havoc
Oldrak, in the temple of the Plains of Havoc

The eccentric inventor {npc:Rapanaio}, hidden in the depths of Kazordoon, swears there is an island full of evil waiting to devour travellers. Help him finish his submarine (mechanical fish, rum, juice, a machine from Scutty and a nautical map), travel with him to the {wiki:Isle of Evil} and kill the six bosses of the castle. You get access to the island, 6666 experience, the {item:Fan Doll of King Tibianus}, the {item:Mechanical Fishing Rod} and two achievements.
Rapanaio, one floor above the Steamship in Kazordoon
Rapanaio, one floor above the Steamship in Kazordoon
In mission 6 (**The Secret**) {npc:Rapanaio}'s submarine takes you to the island; when you complete the quest you get access.
Rapanaio's submarine, in Kazordoon, is the only way to get there (it passes through a level 35 Gate of Expertise).
From mission 5 (**The Map to Evil**): you dig the entrance with a {item:Shovel} between the two mossy stones.
Premium only: a {item:Magic Forcefield} blocks the entrance for ex-premium players.

The Mad Mage summoned more monsters than he could control, and his room, beneath the Ancient Temple of Thais, filled up with creatures. You get the key to the room from {npc:A Prisoner} in Mintwallin (solving a riddle and giving him apples), clear the room and open the chests with the {item:Hat of the Mad}, the {item:Stone Skin Amulet} and the {item:Star Amulet}.

Deep in the {wiki:Thais Dragon Lair|Thais Dragon Lair}, full of dragons, a treasure is hidden. Cross the maze of caves north of Alatar Lake, break a rock with a {item:Pick} and go through the level 40 door to find the chest with the {item:Naginata}.

{npc:The Orc King} guards a treasure in his throne room, protected by the best warriors of the {wiki:Orc Fortress}. Fight your way through the fortress, pass the level 40 door and open the quest boxes at the far north of the throne room to receive a {item:Knight Armor}, a {item:Knight Axe} and a {item:Fire Sword}.
Orc King's throne room (where the boxes are)
Orc King's throne room (where the boxes are)

Join the {creature:Efreet|Efreets}, the green djinns of {wiki:Mal'ouquah|Mal'ouquah}, in the war against the {creature:Marid|Marids}. In three missions you find the supply thief, steal the {item:Tear of Daraman} from the blue djinns and swap King Gabel's lamp for Fa'hradin's lamp. At the end you can trade with {npc:Yaman} and {npc:Alesar}, who buy and sell strong equipment.
Mission 3 (*Orc Fortress*): when you report to {npc:Malor}, you can trade with {npc:Yaman} and {npc:Alesar}.
You can only ally with **one** faction: after this one you can no longer do {wiki:The Djinn War - Marid Faction}.
Hunting Marids and Blue Djinns in Ankrahmun and Yalahar
Mission 3 (*Orc Fortress*): after reporting, ask {npc:Malor} for a {key:task}.

The Marid (blue djinns) and the Efreet (green djinns) are at war in the desert. Ally with the Marid of {wiki:Ashta'daramai|Ashta'daramai}: get a recipe book for the cook, fetch a spy's report from the enemy fortress and swap the lamp of the Efreet leader, {npc:Malor}, for a cursed one. At the end you can trade with {npc:Haroun} and {npc:Nah'Bob}, you receive 3 {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires} and you can hunt Efreets and Green Djinns.
Melchior, in the streets of Ankrahmun
Melchior, in the streets of Ankrahmun
When you report mission 3 (Malor's lamp) to {npc:Gabel}.
You can only choose one faction: after this you can no longer do {wiki:The Djinn War - Efreet Faction|Efreet Faction}.
Green Djinn hunting task (Killing in the Name of...)
At the end of the quest: say {key:task} to {npc:Gabel}.
Hunting Efreets and Green Djinns in Ankrahmun and Yalahar
At the end of the quest.

The outlaws of the {wiki:Outlaw Camp} hid a very powerful sword and protected it with traps and puzzles. You collect four keys, take a barrel through the caves to stop a moving wall, use a {item:Power Ring} on a switch and make your way to the chest with the {item:Bright Sword} and a {item:Red Gem}.
Outlaw Camp, next to the minotaur tower
Outlaw Camp, next to the minotaur tower

Beneath {wiki:Villa Scapula}, a ruined mansion in the swamp north of Venore, lurks the {creature:Black Knight}, former commander of the Royal Army. Cross the caves full of skeletons and bonelords, pass the level 50 door, kill the knight and collect the {item:Crown Armor} and the {item:Crown Shield} from the dead trees in his room.
Villa Scapula (ruin in the swamp north of Venore)
Villa Scapula (ruin in the swamp north of Venore)

The orcs of Ulderek's Rock are preparing for war and the guard {npc:Baxter}, at the door of Thais castle, needs volunteers. You can repair outposts, set fire to ballistas, catapults and siege towers and spy on the orcs' war plans. Each task gives 1000 experience (2000 at the top rank) and, as you collect "achievements", you rise in rank up to **War Hero**, with an experience bonus at each promotion.
Baxter, at the door of Rain Castle in Thais
Baxter, at the door of Rain Castle in Thais
1–2 hours (if you already have the items) + 2 h waiting for the helmet

The {wiki:Knight Outfits|Knight Outfit} can be used by any player; this quest gives both addons. The sword is forged by {npc:Morgan}, in Sabrehaven, in exchange for iron ore. The ornate helmet is awarded by {npc:Gregor}, leader of the knights' guild in Thais, after you prove your worth with four tasks; {npc:Sam} finishes the helmet. You also earn the achievement **In Shining Armor**.
Depends on collecting items (several days); 30 min per addon to hand in

Quest for the {wiki:Mage Outfits|Mage Outfit} addons. Female characters get the Fluid Belt (vial lottery with {npc:Sandra}) and the Tiara (ingredients for {npc:Myra} in Port Hope). Male characters get the Wand (rescue {npc:Angelina} in the Dark Cathedral and deliver ingredients to {npc:Lynda}) and the Hat (deliver {item:Ferumbras' Hat} to {npc:Zoltan}). The quest also gives the achievement **Alumni** (male) or **Ritualist** (female).

At the bottom of Edron's Hero Cave there are two chests with rings. You cross the cave full of {creature:Hero|Heroes} and other human and magical creatures, following the route map, and open the chests to receive a {item:Time Ring} and a {item:Sword Ring}.
Several hours collecting Coal (the hand-in itself takes 10–15 min)

An old dwarf explorer, {npc:Junkar}, discovered a steamship route along underground rivers between Thais and Kazordoon. If the server hands him 200 {item:Coal|Coals}, the boat starts running from the next server save and you can travel (one way only) from Thais to Kazordoon and, depending on the state of the Awash world change, to Robson's Isle.
Ancient Temple entrance, north of Thais
Ancient Temple entrance, north of Thais
Junkar's steamship from Thais to Kazordoon
From the server save after handing in 200 {item:Coal|Coals} to {npc:Junkar}: {key:passage}, {key:Kazordoon}.
Temporary: only until the server save after it starts; one-way trip.
With the steamship active, {npc:Junkar} can take you there, depending on the state of the {wiki:Awash|Awash} world change.
Temporary: only while the steamship is active.

In the {wiki:Hero Cave}, north of Edron, a group of {creature:Priestess|Priestesses} guards something very valuable. Go down to the main hunting floor (where you reach the Demons), clear the last room and open the box in the corner to receive 5 {item:Strong Mana Potion|Strong Mana Potions}.
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron
Highly variable (several days collecting items; the lottery depends on luck)

The Summoner Outfit is available to any Premium player; this quest gives you both addons. Men get the Fluid Belt in {npc:Sandra}'s vial lottery (Edron) and the second addon by helping {npc:Myra} in Port Hope. Women get the Wand through {npc:Lynda}'s ritual (Thais) and the Hat by handing in {item:Ferumbras' Hat} to {npc:Zoltan}. With the full outfit you get the achievement **Ritualist** (male) or **Alumni** (female).

Legend has it that a lost tribe of dwarves settled on an island near Yalahar. Discover the hidden city of {wiki:Beregar|Beregar} beneath Fenrock and help its inhabitants in a series of missions: repair the elevator, prove {npc:Nokmir}'s innocence, deliver a chocolate cake, save the emperor's son from the trolls and bribe a guard with beer. You get access to the Beregar mines, {item:Dwarven Legs}, {item:Rusted Armor}, {item:Crystal of Focus}, {item:Gold Ingot}, {item:Small Topaz|Small Topazes} and, at level 100, the {item:Firewalker Boots}.
First part of the quest: talk about Mistrock with {npc:Maris} once you are in Mistrock ({key:mistrock}) and use the {item:Pick} on the crack in the Fenrock cave.
You need Premium and access to Yalahar.
Ore cart between the start of the path (Fenrock) and Beregar
On your first visit, when you activate the cart on the yellow floor south of {npc:Nokmir}.
Beregar Mines (east, north, west and south mines)

East mine with *Going Down* ({npc:Xorlosh}'s elevator); north mine with *Justice for All* ({npc:Nokmir}'s door); west mine with *Sweet as Chocolate Cake* ({npc:Frafnar}); south mine with *The Good Guard* ({npc:Grombur}).

When this Mini World Change is active, a wandering orc camp appears in one of three places on the continent. Clear the orcs from the camp to make {creature:Bibby Bloodbath} appear and kill her to earn the achievement **Bibby's Bloodbath**.
Camp north of the Jakundaf Desert (one of the possible locations)
Camp north of the Jakundaf Desert (one of the possible locations)

An old paper dropped by a pirate during the Liberty Bay raids sends you on a treasure hunt: {npc:Wyrdin} deciphers it, you find a poem pointing to Tiquanda, you put together the four parts of a pirate map with the help of {npc:Klaus}, in Nargor, and finally you solve the four seals of Treasure Hunt Island. At the end you get 3 {item:Gold Ingot|Gold Ingots} and a {item:Bejeweled Ship's Telescope}.

At the bottom of the Darashia Dragon Lair, north of Darashia, there is a dead dragon with a {item:Life Ring} inside. Cross the lair's three hunting levels, facing {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, and collect the ring.
Darashia Dragon Lair entrance (north of Darashia)
Darashia Dragon Lair entrance (north of Darashia)
30 min (plus the time to clear the dragon lair)

A forgotten secret is guarded by fire and dark walls in the dragon lair north of Ankrahmun. With the {item:Chayenne's Magical Key} and the book {item:Key to Magic (Book)|Key to Magic} from Draconia, you clear the whole lair, reveal a hidden lever and enter the {wiki:Realm of Dreams|Realm of Dreams}, where a {item:Beach Backpack} full of memories awaits you.
about 3h45 with everything prepared (collecting the materials can take days)

{npc:Bozo}, the jester of Thais, accepts you into the Fools Guild and sends you on eleven prank missions around the world: steal the dwarven emperor's beard, put a whoopee cushion on the throne of the queen of Carlin, deliver exploding cookies to ten NPCs and scare the caliph of Darashia dressed as a mummy. In return you receive the {wiki:Jester Outfits|Jester Outfit}, both addons ({item:Jester Staff} and {item:Jester Hat}) and three achievements.

Deep in the Fibula dungeon, beyond a level 50 door, there is a cave full of minotaurs and dragons. At the end of the cave, scattered among the corpses of humans, skeletons and dragons, are five treasures: {item:Knight Axe}, {item:Warrior Helmet}, {item:Elven Amulet}, {item:Tower Shield} and {item:Dwarven Ring}.
4–8 hours (7 missions with travelling all over Tibia)

The secret services of Thais (TBI), Venore (AVIN) and Carlin (CGB) want to uncover all the secrets of Tibia. You choose **one** of the three agencies and carry out seven espionage and sabotage missions around the world. The last mission is the same for everyone: killing the {creature:Mad Technomancer} in Kazordoon. At the end you receive a {item:Mysterious Package} containing a different multi-purpose tool for each agency.
Chester Kahs (TBI, Thais) — or Uncle (AVIN, Venore) / Emma (CGB, Carlin)
Chester Kahs (TBI, Thais) — or Uncle (AVIN, Venore) / Emma (CGB, Carlin)

The necromancer {npc:Omrabas}, hidden in the ruins of {wiki:Drefia|Drefia}, wants to come back to life. Over three volumes you gather body parts for him, consecrate the five altars of the star-shaped room and recover the five pieces of an enchantment scroll. In the end the ritual fails (the scroll was a chicken soup recipe!) and Omrabas, furious, gives you the {item:Nail Case}, needed to tame the {wiki:Hellgrip|Hellgrip} mount.
Loose Stone Pile leading to Omrabas's hideout, Drefia
Loose Stone Pile leading to Omrabas's hideout, Drefia
At the end of the quest {npc:Omrabas} gives you the {item:Nail Case}, with which you can tame a {creature:Gravedigger}.
30 min – 2 hours (depends a lot on luck)

{npc:Captain Haba}, in Svargrond, is hunting a sea serpent in the northern seas. Bring him fish to make bait, set out with him to the open sea and use the telescope to tell him where the creature is. When you find it, you get access to the underwater caves with {creature:Sea Serpent|Sea Serpents}.
Sea Serpent Area (underwater caves of the Sea Serpents)
When you find the serpent with the telescope and ask {npc:Captain Haba} for {key:caves}.
You need a {item:Helmet of the Deep} to go down underwater.

A long quest in the Shattered Isles, south of Liberty Bay: you help the rebel pirates of {wiki:Meriana|Meriana} (Sabrehaven) against the raiding pirates of {wiki:Nargor|Nargor}. Along the way you unlock Goroma, the Goroma volcano (lair of {creature:Morgaroth}), Ramoa, Talahu, Malada, Kharos (Ferumbras Citadel), the Laguna Islands and Nargor. At the end you receive a {item:Model Ship}, the {wiki:Pirate Outfits|Pirate Outfits} and the achievement **Matchmaker**.
Jack Fate's boat between Liberty Bay and Goroma
Part *Access to Goroma*: when you hand over the 30 {item:Wood} to {npc:Jack Fate} ({key:sail}, {key:yes}).
With the boat to Goroma (part *Access to Goroma*).
Part *Access to Meriana*: with the password {key:peg leg} that {npc:Charlotta} gives you in {npc:Eleonore}'s message.
When {npc:Marina} accepts the date with the djinn {npc:Ocelus} (2nd {key:date}).
{npc:Chondur}'s counterspell: after you hand him the {item:Dead Black Sheep} you can cross Goroma's energy barrier.
When you reach Ramoa's Teleportation Hub and use the left teleport to Goroma: from then on you can go to Ramoa through the Goroma hub whenever you like.
With access to Ramoa through the Goroma teleport.
After the mushroom puzzle in Ramoa, when you reach Talahu's Teleportation Hub and use the left teleport.
With access to Talahu through the Teleportation Hub.
You still have to pass a level door (Gate of Expertise) underground in Talahu.
When you reach Malada's Teleportation Hub and use the teleport to Talahu.
With access to Malada: you go down through the trapdoor to the south.
After trying to step on the barrier in Kharos and asking {npc:Zoltan} in Edron for permission ({key:permission}, {key:yes}).
500 gp to Zoltan for **each** entry. This is where {creature:Ferumbras} spawns.
Sebastian's boat from Meriana to Nargor
When you reach **Friendly** reputation in Sabrehaven and ask {npc:Duncan} for the turtle egg mission (or when you accept Ray's Mission 2).
With access to Nargor (the caves are beneath the island).
After completing the quest, ask {npc:Raymond Striker} for it.
It has one of the pirate bosses at the end.
The wiki only says you can start that quest; it gives no further details.

The minotaur {npc:Curos}, who leads the Zao orcs, is willing to accept help from humans, but only if you prove your worth. You kill a rebel orc leader and destroy the magic device the lizards use to spy on the orcs. You receive Tomes of Knowledge and gain access to Curos's daily tasks, which give experience and gold.
Curos, orc camp in the middle of the Zao steppe
Curos, orc camp in the middle of the Zao steppe
After the 2 missions from {npc:Curos} (The Wrath of the Kahn and The Maw of the Dragon).
A random task, each repeatable every 20 hours; they give between 800 and 1800 experience and between 650 and 2250 gold.
1–2 hours of conversations + collecting the items (can take days) + 3 hours of waiting

The barbarian brothers {npc:Bron} and {npc:Ajax} live near Northport. You teach Ajax that violence is not always the answer, help Bron get rid of an annoying kid and gather materials for gifts between the brothers. In return you receive both addons of the **Barbarian Outfit**: the barbarian wig (Bron) and the axe on the back (Ajax), plus the achievement **Brutal Politeness**.
1–2 hours of play + 24 h wait (outfit) + 5 days wait (beard)

The stylist {npc:Hugo}, in Venore, had a vision of a new look: the 'beggar look'. Bring him the materials and he makes you the {wiki:Beggar Outfits|Beggar Outfit}. Then {npc:Simon the Beggar}, south of Fibula, sells you the beard (or the gypsy dress, if you are female) and swaps his staff for the favourite staff he lost in Edron's Hero Cave.

A brave adventurer died facing the terrible {creature:Braindeath}. Go to {wiki:Fenrock|Fenrock}, near {wiki:Beregar|Beregar}, kill the Braindeath next to the lava and open the right coffin to get the adventurer's backpack: a {item:Red Backpack} with potions, tools and 13 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.

In Zao, the lizard {npc:Zalamon} leads a resistance against the undead dragon emperor. You help the resistance spy on the enemy in the Muggy Plains: you steal a tactical map, investigate the Temple of Equilibrium, spy on the village of Chaochai, poison the rice fields, solve the lever puzzle and survive the Phantom Army. You get 10,000 experience, {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge}, the {item:Serpent Crest} (2nd addon of the Warmaster Outfits) and access to daily and weekly tasks.
Zalamon, far east of Zao (1 floor down)
Zalamon, far east of Zao (1 floor down)
After finishing the quest (mission 5, Phantom Army): daily **Zzuppliezz** and weekly **Zze Art of War**.
After the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest} you lose access to {npc:Zalamon} and ask {npc:Chartan} for the tasks, who also has the daily **Collect**.
Nobori addon of the Warmaster Outfits
At the end of mission 5 you receive the {item:Serpent Crest}, which you swap for the addon with {npc:Cael}, in Farmine.
You need this quest completed and the daily task **Zzuppliezz**.

Two {creature:Hero|Heroes} guard a precious treasure deep in the {wiki:Hero Cave}, north of Edron. Go down the cave, pass the dragons and clear the room of the two Heroes to open the two chests: a {item:Club Ring} and a {item:Red Gem}.
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron
A short quest in {wiki:Tiquanda|Tiquanda}, east of Port Hope: cross the jungle to a {creature:Hydra}'s lair, get past it (or kill it) and take a {item:Hydra Egg} from the nest.
Stairs to the Hydra's lair (east of Tiquanda)
Stairs to the Hydra's lair (east of Tiquanda)
30–45 min (then 5–10 min per day for the task)

A rock formation was discovered northwest of Darashia. You collect a flower and holy water, pass the three lion trials to enter the Inner Sanctum and translate four ancient inscriptions that reveal a colour riddle. After that, every day you can place four gems in a room of the sanctuary to make a fountain appear with a random reward, including {item:The Lion's Heart}, which lets you tame the Noble Lion.
When you pass the three lion trials: walk through the {item:Mystic Flame} on the west side of the trials floor.
Permanent access: afterwards you enter without repeating the trials.
Daily task of the gem fountain
After entering the Inner Sanctum and translating the four inscriptions.
Once every 24 hours; random reward, which can be {item:The Lion's Heart} (to tame a {creature:Noble Lion}).
That part requires you to have done the Lion's Rock Quest up to the point where you get access to the temple.

On top of {wiki:Vandura Mountain|Vandura Mountain}, northeast of Liberty Bay, a lone {creature:Medusa} guards her treasure. Climb the mountain among {creature:Wyrm|Wyrms} and {creature:Energy Elemental|Energy Elementals}, kill the Medusa and search the pile of bones to take 4 {item:Black Pearl|Black Pearls}.
2–4 hours for the comb + the time to collect the items for the 2nd addon

The addons of the {wiki:Oriental Outfits|Oriental Outfits} are obtained in Darashia. The first (Scimitar for men, Jewelled Belt for women) requires you to fetch a {item:Coral Comb} from the dangerous waters of Calassa. The second (Turban for men, Veil for women) is a swap: you hand over 100 {item:Ape Fur}, 100 {item:Fish Fin|Fish Fins}, 2 {item:Enchanted Chicken Wing|Enchanted Chicken Wings} and 100 {item:Blue Piece of Cloth|Blue Pieces of Cloth}.

It is said that the last warrior of the Nightmare Knights, Krendorak, was mortally wounded by dragons and died beneath the Plains of Havoc. You descend into the dragon lair, find his body under a fire field and get a {item:Brown Bag} with the {item:Ornamented Shield}, a {item:Might Ring} and other items. With a partner's help you also open a second chest with a {item:Red Bag} containing a {item:Time Ring}.
Hidden hole in the Plains of Havoc
Hidden hole in the Plains of Havoc
Outfit: 5 min; addons: several hours of hunting (or buying the items)

The rebels of {wiki:Meriana} fight against the pirates of Nargor. After gaining their trust in the {wiki:Meriana Quest}, {npc:Raymond Striker} gives you the pirate outfit. The first addon (sabre) is obtained by handing 300 pirate items to {npc:Duncan}; the second (hat) by handing {npc:Ariella} the items of the four pirate leaders.
30 min – 2 hours (depends on how many spirits you catch)

The scientists of the Edron Academy, {npc:Spectulus} and {npc:Sinclair}, founded the Spirithunters and want to study ghosts. You take measurements in a graveyard, test the {item:Spirit Cage} on a {creature:Ghost} and then capture Ghosts, Nightstalkers and Souleaters. You gain experience, platinum coins and the achievement **Afraid of no Ghost!**, and you can repeat the hunt every day.
After mission 3: once a day, {key:research} and {key:yes} to Sinclair.
Same rewards as mission 3. You keep the {item:Spirit Cage}; if you don't take it with you, he gives you a new one.

A thieves' guild has formed beneath Thais. Join it through {npc:Dorian} and carry out 8 missions across the continent: hunt ivory, rob a shop in Carlin, bribe for invitations, sell a bridge that isn't yours disguised as a dwarf, kidnap a goldfish, blackmail a guard and leave a message in the Dark Cathedral. At the end you can trade with {npc:Black Bert} and choose a special weapon.
When you report the last mission (8, Message) to {npc:Dorian}; Black Bert is upstairs.

At the bottom of Edron's Hero Cave, guarded by {creature:Hero|Heroes} and a {creature:Dark Apprentice}, there are two chests with a {item:Wedding Ring} and a {item:Dragon Necklace}. Follow the route through the cave, defeat the Heroes and open the chests.
1–2 hours per attempt (25 waves) + luck with the drops

A magic tower appeared out of nowhere east of Edron, created by a mad mage. Help its servants clear the slime fungus, survive 25 waves of mechanical servants and bring 20 {item:Slime Mould|Slime Moulds} to the {npc:Broken Servant Sentry} in Farmine to receive the {wiki:Elementalist Outfits|Elementalist Outfit}. The addons come from the {creature:Mad Mage}'s {item:Mage's Cap} and the {creature:Raging Mage}'s {item:Elemental Spikes}.
Servant Sentry, tower south of Telas's house (Edron)
Servant Sentry, tower south of Telas's house (Edron)
Several days (10 missions; mission 5 needs a group of 4)

Yalahar is being attacked by vampires. Help the inquisitor {npc:Julius} unmask the vampires hidden in the city, map the island of {wiki:Vengoth|Vengoth}, enter the cursed castle and destroy the four vampire brothers: {creature:Boreth}, {creature:Lersatio}, {creature:Marziel} and {creature:Arthei}. At the end you get access to Vengoth and the castle, the {item:Vampiric Crest} (used in the {wiki:Yalaharian Outfits Quest|Yalaharian} addons), about 13200 experience and, optionally, the {item:Blood Goblet}.
Harlow's boat between Yalahar and Vengoth
From mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*): talk to {npc:Harlow} at the Trade Quarter docks ({key:vengoth}).
100 gp to go and 50 gp to come back.
From mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*), on {npc:Harlow}'s boat; when you complete the quest you get access to Vengoth.
First entry in mission 5 (*Into the Castle*), with 4 players carrying {item:Blood Crystal (Charged)|charged Blood Crystals}; when you complete the quest you get access to the castle.
From mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*), on {npc:Harlow}'s boat.
Vengoth portal to the Spirit Grounds
From mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*): the portal is on the south coast of Vengoth.
It only opens one portal per day (Kha'zeel, Vengoth or Ghostlands); you need Premium.
An addon of the Yalaharian Outfits
The {item:Vampiric Crest} you receive at the end is used in the {wiki:Yalaharian Outfits Quest} for an addon.
Mission *The Curse Spreads* of the Grimvale Quest
Requires this quest done up to mission 3 (access to Vengoth).
Boss Katex Blood Tongue (mission *Sweet Dreams* of the Threatened Dreams Quest)
Requires this quest up to mission 3, plus the missions *The Curse Spreads* and *An Ancient Feud* of the {wiki:Grimvale Quest}.

Also known as the Blue Legs Quest. Collect the four pieces of a broken amulet scattered around Darama, have {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} of Ab'Dendriel repair it and you get the {item:Koshei's Ancient Amulet}. You can keep the amulet or take it to the Darashia catacombs, kill {creature:Koshei the Deathless} and return it to his corpse to open the reward door: the {item:Blue Legs} and your 5,000 gp back.

Cross the caves north of Carlin and the dangerous {wiki:Maze of Lost Souls} to {wiki:Demona}, the lair of the {creature:Warlock|Warlocks}. In the quest room, guarded by Warlocks and Dragons, you open the chests to receive a {item:Crystal Wand}, a {item:Silver Rune Emblem (Sudden Death)} and the book {item:Twinkiller Rune (Book)}.

On the upper floors of {wiki:Demona}, near Carlin, there are two chests with rings. Cross the pentagram room and the corridors full of {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} and {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists} to receive a {item:Stealth Ring} and an {item:Energy Ring}.
Cave south of Northport (entrance to the MoLS and Demona)
Cave south of Northport (entrance to the MoLS and Demona)

An adventurer died among many dragons in the {wiki:Edron Dragon Lair|Edron Dragon Lair}. Cross the lair, pass the level 60 door, kill 3 {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and 3 {creature:Dragon Lord Hatchling|Dragon Lord Hatchlings} and take a {item:Ring of Healing}, a {item:Dragon Necklace} and 7 {item:Small Diamond|Small Diamonds}. Then open the hidden hole with the Pick to reach the {item:Fire Axe}.
2–4 hours (not counting the Queen of the Banshees Quest)

A talking pig on a farm in Thais says she is a cursed princess who only the world's best kisser can save. To perfect your technique you have to help six NPCs scattered around Tibia (and kiss the Queen of the Banshees). In the end the pig confesses she is just a pig… but reveals where the sword {item:Firlefanz} is hidden.
Farm south of the Thais magic shop (pig NPC)
Farm south of the Thais magic shop (pig NPC)
After learning to mow the lawn (*lawn mowing*) in {npc:Hoggle}'s yard (section 2): only then can you cut the grass at the entrance.
When you give 5 {item:Pick|Picks} to {npc:Budrik} in the Dwarf Mines ({key:hi}, {key:pick}, {key:yes}), in the Dwarven Ghost part.

The chief necromancers of the {wiki:Brotherhood of Bones|Brotherhood of Bones} guard a valuable treasure deep in {wiki:Drefia|Drefia}, west of Darashia. Cross the main dungeon full of undead, pass the level 60 gate and open the coffin holding the {item:Medusa Shield}, the {item:Blue Robe} and the {item:Skull Staff}.

Deep in {wiki:Demona|Demona}, full of {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} and {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}, there is a bookshelf room where two maps and a rare book are hidden. Make your way to Demona, find the bookshelf room and search the shelves for the {item:Tibia Map (Book)|Tibia Map}, the {item:Fields of Glory Map (Book)|Fields of Glory Map} and the {item:Purple Tome}.

On the {wiki:Thaian-Venorean Road}, west of Venore, a nest of {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} guarded by {creature:Mamma Longlegs} appears. Enter the nest and kill her three times to earn the achievement **Nestling**.

The {wiki:Hellgore} volcano erupts on the island of {wiki:Goroma}. During this Mini World Change, instead of the usual monsters, much stronger creatures appear inside the volcano, including {creature:Dragonling|Dragonlings}. Kill 50 fire creatures to earn the achievement **Fire from the Earth** and take the chance to tame a {item:Dragonling (Mount)|Dragonling}.
While the Mini World Change is active, {creature:Dragonling|Dragonlings} appear inside {wiki:Hellgore} and you can tame one.
Quick if you already have the items; collecting the items can take several days (the Mandrake is rare)

After saving the monkeys of Banuta, the shaman {npc:Hairycles} makes you his apprentice and gives you the **Shaman** outfit. Both addons are given by the shaman {npc:Chondur}, in Sabrehaven: the Voodoo Staff (with a Mandrake and 5 Voodoo Dolls) and the Voodoo Mask (with 5 Tribal Masks and 5 Banana Staffs). With everything complete you get the achievement **Way of the Shaman**.
1–3 hours (depends on the size of the team)

A mad mage built a tower in Edron to carry out experiments and his mechanical servants were overrun by fungi. Help {npc:Servant Sentry} clear the {item:Slime Fungus} from the dungeon with a {item:Slime Gobbler}, survive the waves of servants and kill the {creature:Mad Mage}. This is where you get items for the Elementalist outfit and the {item:Golden Can of Oil}.
Ruined tower south of Stonehome, Edron
Ruined tower south of Stonehome, Edron

Beneath the {wiki:Ghostland|Ghostlands} and the {wiki:Isle of the Kings|Isle of the Kings} hides the Queen of the Banshees, protected by seven seals. Cross the catacombs, solve the puzzles of each seal (flames, levers, blood, pearls), receive the kiss of {npc:The Queen Of The Banshees} and enter the final room to take {item:Boots of Haste}, {item:Giant Sword}, {item:Tower Shield}, {item:Stealth Ring}, {item:Stone Skin Amulet} and 100 platinum coins.

A {creature:Warlock} and some {creature:Hero|Heroes} guard their treasure in the caves beneath Edron. Go down through the {wiki:Hero Cave} to the {wiki:Temple of Xayepocax}, clear the room and open the chests behind the level 70 door to receive a {item:Vampire Shield} and a {item:Dragon Lance}. A box outside also gives a {item:Strange Symbol}, a {item:Black Pearl} and a {item:Mysterious Fetish}.
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron

Go down into the depths of {wiki:Cyclopolis}, north of Edron, cross five floors of cyclopes, fire elementals and dragons, and clear a final room with 4 {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths}. Inside you will find a {item:Demon Shield}, a {item:Golden Armor}, a {item:Guardian Halberd}, a {item:Platinum Amulet}, a {item:Life Ring}, a {item:Crystal Ring} and gems.
5 min (once you have the 100 fame points at the Spike)

The gnomes of {wiki:The Spike} reward those who help them with the Spike tasks. With 100 fame points you can buy the **Cave Explorer** outfit and both addons (Headware and Grappling Hook) from {npc:Gnommander}, for a total of 6000 gold. With everything bought you get the achievement **Cave Completionist**.

In the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}, on the island of Svargrond, there are two hidden boxes, each with a {item:Mastermind Potion}. Follow the two paths through the mines, full of {wiki:Voodoo Cultists|voodoo cultists} and golems, to pick up the two potions, some gold and fish.
Stairs to the Formorgar Mines (west of Svargrond)
Stairs to the Formorgar Mines (west of Svargrond)

The pirates of {wiki:Nargor} started mining crystals in a cursed cave, the {wiki:Crystal Gardens}, and strange things began to happen. The pirate {npc:One-Eyed Joe} asks you to destroy the evil crystal deep inside, using a banshee's petrified wail. You can repeat this task every day and you get a {item:Crystal Shard}, a random pirate accessory and the achievement Wail of the Banshee.

Three assassins hidden in the south of the world can give you their equipment. The drunk {npc:Vescu} gives you the Assassin outfit if you help him make a potion to sober up; {npc:Erayo} gives you the first addon (the head) in exchange for a lot of cloth and thread; and {npc:Atrad} gives you the second addon (the katana) for a {item:Behemoth Claw} and a {item:Nose Ring}.
Vescu, hut north of Port Hope
Vescu, hut north of Port Hope

{npc:Rotem Valos}, of the Adventurers' Guild, needs help mapping the lands of Tibia. He gives you an {item:Adventurer's Map} and a list of 18 places to explore (all added in version 10.80). You visit each place in any order, use the map there and, when you mark the last one, you get the achievement **Cartography 101**.

Beneath Edron, two races of demons, the {creature:Shaburak Demon|Shaburak} and the {creature:Askarak Demon|Askarak}, have been at war since forgotten times. Players decide the course of the war: the difference in kills between the two factions at each server save makes one of them gain an advantage and summon Lords and, later, Princes. This world change gives you the chance to get the achievements **Shaburak Nemesis** and **Askarak Nemesis**.
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron
Hero Cave entrance, north of Edron
Months (thousands of dragons, half-yearly events and lots of gold)

The Dragon Slayer outfit is one of the most demanding in the game: you need to kill thousands of {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, gather hundreds of scales and leathers, pay tens of millions of gold and obtain the rare {item:Bottled Dragon Breath} from the world boss of {wiki:Nimmersatt's Lair}. Everything is handed to {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} with the phrase {key:Dragon Slayer Attire}.
Addon 1: 15 min (with the items); Addon 2: several hours + waiting for the flower (up to 1 month)

The two addons of the {wiki:Druid Outfits|Druid Outfit}. The first (bear/wolf paws) is a simple swap with {npc:Ustan} in Port Hope. The second (bear/wolf skin) requires earning the respect of the druid {npc:Ceiron}, in Ab'Dendriel, with four tasks (a rare flower in Nargor, pure water from a hydra cave, demon dust and a lost necklace in the Orc Fortress) until you can talk to the she-wolf Faolan in Cormaya.

Every month, between the 12th and the 15th, the full moon rises over the island of Grimvale and the peaceful {creature:Bandit|Bandits} turn into fearsome {wiki:Were-Creatures|were-creatures}. These are the days when you can do the {wiki:Grimvale Quest} and, on the 13th, face the boss {creature:Feroxa}.
Only during the full moon, between the 12th and 15th of each month.
On the 13th you can also face the boss {creature:Feroxa}.
Several days (independent missions; part depends on the full moon and timers)

A curse turns the inhabitants of the island of {wiki:Grimvale|Grimvale} into were-creatures at every full moon, and the disease is spreading to Edron, Cormaya, the Darama desert and Oskayaat. This quest has four independent parts: **The Curse of the Full Moon** (access to the boss {creature:Feroxa}), **The Curse Spreads** ({item:Foxtail Amulet} and achievement **Over the Moon**), **An Ancient Feud** (achievement **Drama in Darama**, shortcuts to the {wiki:Lion Sanctum|Lion Sanctum} and trades with {npc:Domizian}) and **Paradise Lost** ({item:Toy Ball} to tame the Foxmouse, access to Oskayaat and a treasure chest).
Cornell, ferry to Grimvale (north of Stonehome, Edron)
Cornell, ferry to Grimvale (north of Stonehome, Edron)
Part **The Curse of the Full Moon**: after handing 3 {item:Purple Nightshade Blossoms} to {npc:Maeryn} and killing 50 were-creatures.
The lair opens on the **13th** of each month, when the raid starts.
Part **The Curse Spreads**: after the ritual in the Moonshadow Temple of Grimvale.
Death Portals between the Last Sanctum and the Edron dungeon
Part **The Curse Spreads**: when {npc:Daniel Steelsoul} gives you the {item:Foxtail Amulet}, after you kill the 5 mini-bosses.
Part **An Ancient Feud**: in {npc:Domizian}'s final reward (Lion Mosaics).
The door between the Sanctum and the Hyaena Lairs, and the statue on top of Lion's Rock that takes you to the Sanctum entrance.
Part **An Ancient Feud**: in {npc:Domizian}'s final reward, in Darashia.
Part **Paradise Lost**: after recovering the stolen {item:Ocarina} in the {wiki:Mother of Scarabs Lair|Mother of Scarabs Lair} and returning to {npc:Tonar}, in Ankrahmun.
Locked doors of Oskayaat (NPCs and training statues)
Part **Paradise Lost**: 20 hours after the ritual, when {npc:Niral} gives you the {item:Toy Ball}.
Foxmouse's lair and the Treasure Chest room (Oskayaat)
Part **Paradise Lost**, at the end (with {npc:Niral}'s {item:Toy Ball}).
The chest room is opened by using a {item:Moonlight Ipomea's Stamen} on the twines between the {item:Symbol of Fire} and the {item:Symbol of Sula (Silver)}.
Part **Paradise Lost**: use the {item:Toy Ball} on the Foxmouse to tame it.
Cursed characters cannot tame it: eat {item:Purple Nightshade Blossoms} first.
You need the parts **The Curse Spreads** and **An Ancient Feud**.
Together with the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest|Blood Brothers Quest} up to mission 3, they give access to the boss {creature:Katex Blood Tongue}, requested in *Sweet Dreams*.
Several sessions (missions with a 20 h wait; 3 days minimum for the Ogre Chef)

A set of seven short missions for the inhabitants of Krailos: the explorer {npc:Larek}, the shaman {npc:Ghorza}, the chief {npc:Vuzrog}, the ogre foreman {npc:Grubokk} and the rebellious goblins of {npc:Nibble}. You get access to the Krailos depot, can trade with the island's NPCs, and receive an {item:Onyx Pendant}, a {item:Shaggy Ogre Bag}, Opals, potions and the achievements **Ogre Chef** and **The Call of the Wild**.
When you hand the amulet to {npc:Larek} (end of the mission **Hungry New World**): use the grate inside his tent.
In the depot room, beneath {npc:Larek}'s tent, after the mission **Hungry New World**.
When you receive the {item:Onyx Pendant} at the end of the mission **The Great Hunger**.
Mugruu's shop (weapons, ammo and creature products)
When you hand the hunting mission **The Thunder Tusk Clan** to {npc:Vuzrog}.
With the {item:Key 0555} (Goblin Bone Key), which you take from the well next to {npc:Grubokk} in the mission **Survival of the Strongest**.
Depends on the Ice Islands Quest and collecting shards

The {wiki:Norseman Outfits|Norseman Outfit} protects you from the endless winter of {wiki:Hrodmir|Hrodmir}. You get the outfit by completing {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest} and the addons by handing frostheart shards ({item:Shard|Shards}) to the shaman {npc:Hjaern}, in Svargrond: 5 shards for the Spear and 10 more for the Hood/Earmuffs. You also get the achievement **Out in the Snowstorm**.
After handing in 15 shards in total.

The Fire-Feathered Serpent sleeps beneath the sea of Oramond. When the players on the server kill 2000 {creature:Seacrest Serpent|Seacrest Serpents}, it wakes up and the normal quaras and serpents of the {wiki:Seacrest Grounds|Seacrest Grounds} are replaced by {wiki:Quara#Quara_Renegades|Renegade Quaras}. While it lasts, the mission The Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent of the {wiki:Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest|Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest} becomes available, which gives access to the achievements **Mind the Step!** and **Snake Charmer**.
Guide Kunibert, Rathleton (ask about the serpent's status)
Guide Kunibert, Rathleton (ask about the serpent's status)
Mission *The Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent* of the {wiki:Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest}
Only available while this world change is active.
This is the mission where you earn the achievements **Mind the Step!** and **Snake Charmer**.
Several days (depends on the server killing 2000 Yielothax)

In the southwest of the {wiki:Zao Steppe}, a {creature:Raging Mage} opened a portal to another dimension at the top of a tower. As long as he is alive, you can cross the portal and hunt {creature:Yielothax} (rare loot) and maybe tame a {wiki:Uniwheel (Mount)|Uniwheel}. When the whole world kills 2000 Yielothax, the mage weakens and can be killed, leaving his unique loot.
In the {wiki:Yielothax Dimension|other dimension}, after crossing the portal at the top of the tower.
Only while the {creature:Raging Mage} is in the tower (world change active). You need Premium and Mission 2 of the {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
Several days of attempts (each jar takes about 10–80 attempts)

The pharaoh {creature:Horestis} sleeps in his tomb near Ankrahmun, sealed by five {item:Ornate Canopic Jar|Ornate Canopic Jars}. When the players on the server break all five jars, Horestis wakes up and can be fought. The reward of this world change is access to the {creature:Sandstone Scorpion} as a mount.
Ramp to the Horestis Tomb, outside Ankrahmun
Ramp to the Horestis Tomb, outside Ankrahmun
Reward of this world change: depends on Horestis being woken on your server.
Several weeks (you can only hand in 1 tome every 20 hours)

The dwarf {npc:Cael}, sage of Farmine, wants to learn everything about the continent of Zao. Scattered around Zao are 12 {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge}: most are found during the missions of other Zao quests. Each tome you hand him unlocks something new: decorations and backpacks for sale, trades with NPCs, the serpent teleport and access to the Corruption Hole and the Zao Palace.
Dragon Tapestries, Minotaur Backpacks and Dragon Backpacks for sale from Pompan
Dragon Tapestry with **1** tome handed in, Minotaur Backpack with **2** and Dragon Backpack with **5**.
Lizard Weapon Rack for sale from Esrik
Rice trade with Swolt (Bunch of Ripe Rice for 10 Rice Balls)
War Drums and Didgeridoo for sale from Cael
It is one-way only: it takes you to the Muggy Plains teleport, south of the Dragonblaze Peaks.
You also need to have finished {wiki:The New Frontier Quest|The New Frontier Quest}.
Dragon Statue and Dragon Throne made by Cael
Dragon Statue with **11** tomes (in exchange for a {item:Red Lantern}); Dragon Throne with **12** (in exchange for a {item:Red Piece of Cloth}).

The ghost of the pirate {npc:Mr Brandon}, northwest of Rathleton, stole sacred treasures from the sea floor and is now cursed. Help him recover the wedding ring, return the mother-of-pearl slabs to the altars and find the time compass of the Sunken City, always with the help of the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}. In return you gain access to the three zones of the {wiki:Seacrest Grounds|Seacrest Grounds} and, during the Fire-Feathered Serpent world change, three crystal shards, a Ring of Healing and two achievements.
Lost Mountains (west teleport of the Seacrest Grounds)
Mission *Souls Lost At Sea*: when you hand the {item:Brandon's Wedding Ring} to {npc:Mr Brandon}.
Sunken City (east teleport of the Seacrest Grounds)
Mission *Drowned Altars*: after repairing the three altars and talking to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}.
Birthing Grounds (north teleport of the Seacrest Grounds)
Mission *The Sunken City*: when you hand the {item:Time Compass} to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}.
Depends on how long it takes you to collect 100 Vampire Lord Tokens

The inquisitor {npc:Storkus}, in Kazordoon, rewards those who bring him proof of the death of {wiki:Vampire Lords|Vampire Lords}: the {item:Vampire Lord Token|Vampire Lord Tokens}. By handing in 100 tokens in six batches you climb six vampire hunter ranks and earn a total of 186,000 experience points, a {item:Vampire Doll}, the achievement **Razing!** and access to the {item:Blood Skull} in the Vengoth Castle basement.
Storkus, west of the Dwarf Bridge (near Kazordoon)
Storkus, west of the Dwarf Bridge (near Kazordoon)
Blood Skull in the Vengoth Castle basement
When you reach the **Razing** rank (batch of 50 {item:Vampire Lord Token|Vampire Lord Tokens}) with {npc:Storkus}.
Depends on collecting the items; the hand-ins take about 3 hours (includes 2 hours of waiting)

The addons of the {wiki:Warrior Outfits|Warrior Outfit}, the lighter version of the knight outfit. You get the first addon (spiked shoulder pads) from {npc:Trisha}, leader of the knights' guild in Carlin, and it is made by {npc:Cornelia}. The second addon (the sword) is forged by {npc:Morgan}, in Sabrehaven. With both addons you get the achievement Wild Warrior.

Winter event on {wiki:Percht Island}, reached by a boat near the port of Svargrond. You gather three percht parts to make a disguise, enter the frozen hall and thaw {creature:The Percht Queen} with bonfires and Warm Fires before killing her. You get the Percht Raider outfit (and addons in later years), access to the sleigh mounts and, at the end of the event, all worlds receive a week of double respawn and regeneration.
Boat to Percht Island, Svargrond port
Boat to Percht Island, Svargrond port
Percht sleigh mounts (Dark, Bright and Cold Percht Sleigh)
After taking part in the event once; with 2 and 3 participations you can upgrade them to the next variants.
You pay with {item:Percht Skull|Percht Skulls}: 3 for the first sleighs and 1 per mount for each upgrade.

The Wizard outfit is now available to all Premium accounts; this quest gives you both addons. For the first (Skull Mask / Snake Tiara) you sacrifice four valuable items to {npc:Lugri}, a follower of Zathroth hidden near Thais. For the second (Skull Shoulder Pad / Wings) you bring 50 {item:Holy Orchid|Holy Orchids} to {npc:The Queen Of The Banshees}.

A journey through the history of Tibia's development. Use the Thais time machine to enter the {wiki:Time Travel Dungeon|Time Travel Dungeon}, cross replicas of old zones in reverse order of release (from Forest of Life to Thais), complete an album of 8 photographs and defeat {creature:Lord Retro} in a 4-phase fight. You receive the achievement **First Achievement** and the base {wiki:Formal Dress Outfits|Formal Dress Outfits}.
Northeast wall tower of Thais (time machine)
Northeast wall tower of Thais (time machine)
Time Travel Dungeon (free entry and exit)
In section 4, when you repair the time machine with the {item:Bronze Gear Wheel}, the {item:Copper Valve (Item)|Copper Valve}, the {item:Calibrated Indicator Gauge} and the {item:Glass Tube}.
From then on you enter and leave through the time machine in the basement of the **northeast** wall tower of Thais.
The purple teleport in the {wiki:Memory of a Werelion|Memory of a Werelion} room now takes you near the boss teleport.
The time of the 25 Years of Tibia Quest + 1 min for the addons

The {wiki:Formal Dress Outfits|Formal Dress Outfit} is the reward for defeating {creature:Lord Retro} at the end of the {wiki:25 Years of Tibia Quest}. The two addons (the tailcoat and the hat) are unlocked by using a {item:Brass Button} and a {item:Decorative Plume}. With both addons you get the achievement **Sharp Dressed**.
Thais northeast tower (Time Travel Dungeon entrance)
Thais northeast tower (Time Travel Dungeon entrance)
Several days (the swan feathers and the cloak require 20-hour waits)

The fae, nature spirits that hide in animals, trees and stones, ask for your help to prove you are worthy of entering the secret island of {wiki:Feyrist|Feyrist}. After helping animals all over the continent, you gain access to Feyrist, find a fairy treasure, rebuild the magic barrier against the nightmares of Roshamuul and finally make your way to {wiki:Candia|Candia}. You receive, among others, {item:Butterfly Ring}, {item:Blossom Bag}, {item:Sun Catcher}, {item:Moon Mirror}, {item:Starlight Vial} and {item:Swan Feather Cloak}.
Alkestios, southwest of the Ab'Dendriel gates
Alkestios, southwest of the Ab'Dendriel gates
At the end of *Troubled Animals* (after *The Swan Maiden*), when {npc:Alkestios} marks you with the fae seal.
Each trip through the shrines uses up a {item:Small Amethyst}, {item:Small Emerald}, {item:Small Ruby} or {item:Small Sapphire}; you don't need a gem to come back.
In *Sweet Dreams*, when you make the {item:Gingerbread Key (Moon Melon, Raspberry and Lemon)} in Feyrist's oven.
You enter through the giant donut in the **east** of Feyrist.
With access to Candia: they are beneath the Gingerbread Castle.
Trades with Coco and Toffee (Candy Carnival)
In *Sweet Dreams*, after the chocolate mines, when the {npc:Sugar Plum Fairy} reopens the Candy Carnival.

The scientist {npc:Telas}, in Stonehome (Edron), wants to build his own golem in the style of the Yalahari. Over 13 missions you collect research notes all over the continent, steal parts from the Yalahar factories, charge yourself with energy, read books that give you headaches and fetch a golem head from Fenrock. At the end you get 25,000 experience, a {item:Golem Wrench} to tame a {wiki:Modified Gnarlhound} (mount), 5 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, the achievement **Golem in the Gears** and you can trade with Telas.
Telas's house in Stonehome (go up the stairs)
Telas's house in Stonehome (go up the stairs)
In mission 13: open the box in {npc:Telas}'s laboratory and use the {item:Golem Wrench} on one of the Modified Gnarlhounds in the cage.
Trades with Telas (rare metals and crystals)
After mission 13: say {key:trade} to {npc:Telas} to sell him rare metals and crystals.
2–4 hours (plus the time to gather a team and the gems)

An experiment by Magister Alverus went wrong and he was frozen in the Ivory Towers of Edron. {npc:Arkulius} sends you to the elemental sphere of your vocation to defeat an Overlord and bring back its elemental matter. Then a team with one character of each vocation summons and kills the {creature:Lord of the Elements}. Each vocation receives its own equipment and everyone gets the achievement **Lord of the Elements**.
Arkulius, top floor of the southeast tower of the Ivory Towers
Arkulius, top floor of the southeast tower of the Ivory Towers
Many hours, spread over several days (14 main missions + 6 extra)

Join the {wiki:Tibian Explorer Society|Explorer Society} in Port Hope or Northport and rise in rank (Novice, Journeyman, Relic Hunter, Explorer) by doing missions all over Tibia: ancient ice from Folda, butterflies, plants from Tiquanda, the lizards' urn, orc dust, an elven book, the Memory Stone, the Queen of the Banshees' dress and much more. At the end you gain access to the astral bridges (Port Hope ↔ Northport and Liberty Bay ↔ Svargrond), to {wiki:Calassa} and the Frozen Trench, 6 {item:Orichalcum Pearl|Orichalcum Pearls}, a {item:Crown Backpack} and three achievements.
When you reach the **Novice** rank (end of Joining the Explorers): {npc:Captain Max}, in Liberty Bay, will take you to Yalahar.
This is the usual requirement for the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}; alternatively there is the password from {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice} (boat from Thais).
When you reach the **Relic Hunter** rank: you can buy them at the Explorer Society headquarters.
In the extra mission **The Undersea Kingdom**: {npc:Berenice} tells {npc:Captain Max} to take you there and, after you hand in the logbook, you get access.
To accept the mission you need the **Relic Hunter** rank.
After The Undersea Kingdom, in the extra mission **The Frozen Trench** (with {npc:Lurik}, in Svargrond).
Also requires progress in {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}; you need a {item:Helmet of the Deep} and {spell:Levitate}.
In the last mission, **The Astral Portals** (Explorer rank).
Uses 1 {item:Orichalcum Pearl} per trip; Premium only.
When you report the extra mission **The Ice Music** to {npc:Lurik}.
Uses 1 {item:Orichalcum Pearl} per trip; Premium only.
After **The Astral Portals**: you can buy them from the Explorer Society representatives.

The dwarves of Kazordoon have set up a new mine, **Farmine**, on a distant continent (Zao). {npc:Ongulf} needs you to explore the region, bring help from Kazordoon, make peace with the cavemen, the orcs and the lizards and, in the end, win the great tournament in the Isle of Strife arena. You get the base **Warmaster** outfit, Tomes of Knowledge, 8000 experience, several potions and access to the south and centre of Zao (and Farmine grows with each mission).
As soon as you start mission 1 (*New Land*); the north part only opens in a later mission.
Only with the {wiki:The Mage's Tower World Change} active.
Mission 3 (*Strangers in the Night*): Farmine moves to phase 2.
Opens as you do the quest's missions.
The wiki only says they become accessible after a certain mission of the quest.
Lizard teleport from the Zao Steppe to the Muggy Plains
After the **first 8 missions** (you leave through it at the end of mission 8).
It gives access to the Muggy Plains and the zones beyond them (Souleater Mountains, Nimmersatt's Breeding Ground, Temple of Equilibrium).
Mission 9 (*Mortal Combat*): {npc:Zurak}, in the Muggy Plains, takes you to the island ({key:trip}, free).
Mission 10 (*New Horizons*): {npc:Ongulf} authorises you to use the carpet at the top of the elevator, above Farmine.
Carpets are for Premium accounts only.
With the quest completed (including mission 9, *Mortal Combat*).
It is part of the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest}; it takes you to the Muggy Plains, in northern Zao.
With the quest finished and at least **10 tomes** handed in to {npc:Cael} ({wiki:Tomes of Knowledge Quest}).
After mission 8 (*An Offer You Can't Refuse*).
After mission 8, {npc:Cael} accepts up to 6 {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge}; with the quest completed he accepts more.
When you receive mission 9 (*Mortal Combat*); it doesn't need to be completed.
With the quest completed (gives the base Warmaster outfit).
Depends on how many tokens and packages you already have (minutes, if you buy the items from other players)

The {wiki:Crystal Warlord Outfits|Crystal Warlord Outfits} are obtained with three gnomish vouchers. The base outfit and the first addon are swapped for {item:Major Crystalline Token|Major} and {item:Minor Crystalline Token|Minor Crystalline Tokens} with the NPC {npc:Gnomally}, in Gnomegate; the second addon drops, with low probability, from {item:Gnomish Supply Package|Gnomish Supply Packages}. All these items come from the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest} or can be bought from other players.

Find in the Formorgar Mines, near Svargrond, the mine plan (a {item:Map (Brown)|map} on a pile of bones) and the elevator instructions (a {item:Paper|paper} in a box, at the bottom of the mines). With both you unlock the {wiki:Hoist|Hoist}, the elevator at the mine entrance, which takes you quickly between the floors.
With the mine plan (the {item:Map (Brown)|map}) and the instructions (the {item:Paper|paper}): each unlocks different trips between the floors.
Without the map you can't go from floor 1 to floor 2.

An adventurer exploring the icy Formorgar mines, near Svargrond, went deeper than his strength allowed. Follow the map to the Formorgar Mines and find his skeleton next to the stairs: inside are a {item:Shard}, 100 gp, a {item:Bullseye Potion}, a {item:Crossbow} and 20 {item:Power Bolt|Power Bolts}.
Several weeks (1000 War Exp in repeatable missions) + ≈1 hour to climb the tower

To receive the {wiki:Insectoid Outfits|Insectoid Outfits} you have to do the missions of the {wiki:War Against the Hive Quest|War Against the Hive Quest} for {npc:Orockle} and help open the hive ({wiki:Hive Born World Change|Hive Born World Change}). ≈10 min (plus the trip through the Hero Cave)

Deep in Edron's Hero Cave there is a room guarded by a {creature:Demon}. Inside a coffin is a bag with the {item:Key 6010} and other items, but when you touch the yellow parchment on top, 4 more Demons appear. Kill them or grab the prize and run.

The **Soil Guardian** outfit and its two addons are obtained using three gnomish vouchers: the one for the base outfit and the one for the first addon are swapped for {item:Major Crystalline Token|Major} and {item:Minor Crystalline Token|Minor Crystalline Tokens} with {npc:Gnomally} in Gnomegate; the one for the second addon drops, with a bit of luck, from {item:Gnomish Supply Package|Gnomish Supply Packages}. Seven advisors of the Pharaoh each guard, in their own tomb beneath the Ankrahmun desert, a piece of an ancient mask. You go down into the 8 {wiki:Ankrahmun Tombs|tombs}, kill all the {wiki:Pharaohs|pharaohs}, collect the 7 pieces and put them together in {creature:Ashmunrah}'s treasure room to receive the {item:Helmet of the Ancients}.

Ancient Ruins Tomb (Vashresamun), the recommended first pharaoh
Several weeks (daily tasks; minimum ~36 days to Rank IV without buying reputation)

You get access to the gnomes' teleport system, Gnomegate, Gnomebase Alpha and their hunting zones, lots of achievements, tokens, Gnomish Supply Packages and the Warzone loot.

One of Tibia's classic quests, deep in Edron's {wiki:Hero Cave}. Cross the level 100 Gate of Expertise, open the Gate of the Lost Souls with the help of two players and face at least 9 {creature:Demon|Demons} and many {creature:Banshee|Banshees} on the way to the quest room. The Deeplings world change decides how much of {wiki:Fiehonja|Fiehonja}, the underwater city of the {wiki:Deeplings|Deeplings} in Quirefang, is accessible. It has 3 stages: in stage 1 (the normal one) only a small part of Fiehonja is open; in stage 3 you have access to the whole zone. The scientist {npc:Spectulus} discovered a strange island and a giant staircase leading to a world beneath the sea. Follow his notes to {wiki:Gray Beach}, enter {wiki:Fiehonja|Fiehonja} and take part in the missions of the Deeplings world change: sea hearts for the god-king Qjell, purification of Deepling Spawns, coral mines and the Deepling Guardian bosses. You earn the {wiki:Deepling Outfits|Deepling Outfits} with both addons, access to the deepest zones of Fiehonja, random prizes and several achievements.

The shaman {npc:Hairycles}, of Banuta, wants to find true friends among humans. Over 9 missions you go to Trapwood, Carlin, Chor, Ankrahmun, Fibula, the Forbidden Lands and the depths of Banuta to cure the apes' plague and destroy the serpent god's monument. At the end you get the {wiki:Shaman Outfits|Shaman Outfits}, monkey statues for your house and access to the Forbidden Lands and Deeper Banuta.
Hairycles, temple in the southeast of Banuta
Hairycles, temple in the southeast of Banuta

In mission 6 (Witches' Cap Spot), when you become a *friend of the apes*.

At the end of the quest, after receiving the Shaman Outfits.

After passing the Barbarian Test, you help the barbarians of {wiki:Svargrond|Svargrond}: you make friends with the musher {npc:Iskan}, help the shamans of {wiki:Nibelor|Nibelor} against chakoyas and hunters, cure {npc:Nilsor}'s dogs, investigate {wiki:Helheim|Helheim} and uncover the cult of Ghazbaran in the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}. One of Zao's Tibia Tales. The old {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone}, in the Souleater Mountains, asks you to find the last three wills of her family, lost in the ruined houses of the village. When you hand the three {item:Faded Last Will|Faded Last Wills} to the {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone}.

One of Tibia's most famous quests: descend to the {wiki:Pits of Inferno|Pits of Inferno}, beneath the Plains of Havoc, cross the Hall of the Five Ways with a team of all vocations, solve the levers, the spa and the maze and enter the throne rooms of the {wiki:Ruthless Seven|Ruthless Seven}. Absorb the spirit of the seven thrones to open the treasure room, where you receive {item:Soft Boots}, {item:Backpack of Holding}, {item:Stuffed Dragon}, {item:Frozen Starlight}, 100 platinum coins and choose between {item:Arcane Staff}, {item:Avenger} or {item:Arbalest}.

You get the two addons (Nobori and Kabuto) from the sage {npc:Cael}, in Farmine, in exchange for the crests obtained in Zao's big quests: the {item:Serpent Crest} and the {item:Tribal Crest}. Depends on the previous quests (handing in the addons takes 5 min)

With everything complete you get the achievement **Peazzekeeper**.

Help {npc:Zalamon} and the lizard rebels of Zao overthrow the corrupted dragon emperor. You infiltrate northern Zao hidden in a crate, reactivate teleports, kill The Keeper, assemble an ancient sceptre in Deeper Banuta, enter Razachai, invade the palace, free a sleeping dragon through its dream and destroy the emperor's four incarnations and the mutated Zalamon himself. At the end you receive lots of gold and treasures, a draken armour of your choice, the Wayfarer outfit and permanent access to Razachai.
Northern Zao (Northern Zao Plantations, Souleater Mountains, Ghastly Dragon Lair)

Teleport room (lever) in the Hero Cave

You follow the Beggar King's trail to the abandoned sewers, discover ancient ruins, defeat the boss {creature:The Ravager}, investigate the death of the transporter Quandon in a séance and finish off {creature:Death Priest Shargon}. Part 3: after repairing 20 valves, {npc:Jacob} or {npc:Elliott} gives you permission ({key:abandoned sewers}, {key:mission}, {key:ok}, {key:abandoned sewers}).

With each votes tier you go up a rank (Commoner, Inhabitant, Citizen and Squire), get an achievement and unlock new perks: selling loot to NPCs, Slime Slide, boat trips to more cities, the Underground Glooth Factory and the {wiki:Hero of Rathleton Quest}.

{npc:Orockle}, in {wiki:Gray Beach|Gray Beach}, leads the fight against Quirefang's {wiki:Hive Born|Hive Born}. You do repeatable missions (blinding antennae, bursting blobs, collecting acid, plugging pores, killing Kollos, breaking crystals) that give experience, War Exp and Favour and help the server open the hive ({wiki:Hive Born World Change|Hive Born World Change}). With enough War Exp you receive the {wiki:Insectoid Outfits|Insectoid Outfits} and addons, and there are 21 achievements to earn in total.
Inside the Hive (east structure in phase 2; all structures in phase 3)

Server world change ({wiki:Hive Born World Change}), not a personal access; in phase 3 the hive stays open for 5 days.
Hive Cells behind the Hive Gates (Gooey Mass)
With at least **50 Favour**, buy the pheromone from {npc:Orockle} ({key:reward}, {key:yes}); it only works once the hive has started to open.
The pheromone lasts one week and does not get you through the Hive Gates of the east and west towers; each Hive Cell gives 1 {item:Gooey Mass} per week.
Several days (many hours: 300 kills, five bosses and lots of travelling)

{npc:Tarun} wants to know where the Asuri go when they vanish from the {wiki:Asura Palace|Asura Palace}. You defeat three asuri princesses, put together the three parts of the {item:Asuri Talisman} and discover the island of {wiki:Marapur|Marapur}, where you help the nagas of the coast and the mountain: you heal the beavers, save the sage Timira, repair the observatory, organise the wedding of {npc:Candra} and {npc:Nihaka} and recover the stolen eggs. You gain access to Marapur, the {item:Colourful Water Lily} ({wiki:Giant Beaver (Mount)|Giant Beaver} mount), the {item:Lilypad Backpack}, the {item:Naga Nest} and the achievement **Wedding Planner**.

Secret cults are hidden all over Tibia. The druid {npc:Gerimor}, in Feyrist, asks you to investigate seven cults (Barkless, Misguided, Patron of the Arts, Orc Idol, Sandy Cave, Minotaurs and Zathroth Remnants) and defeat their bosses. Cult bosses (Ravenous Hunger, The Souldespoiler, The Unarmored Voidborn, The Sandking, The False God, Essence of Malice)

A long quest of binary-code riddles that takes you all over Tibia following the story of the Planegazers. You start by finding an {item:Opticording Sphere} in a secret chamber in Ab'Dendriel, collect five visions, activate several ancient forges, defeat the {creature:Last Planegazer} and forge {item:The Supreme Cube}, inside which you solve 30 puzzle rooms until you face the {creature:Planestrider}. You receive the {item:Mysterious Metal Egg}, the {item:Lightsphere}, {item:The Supreme Cube}, a {item:Monolith of the Planes Kit} and the title *Planegazer*.

You receive the {wiki:Demon Hunter Outfits|Demon Hunter Outfit} with both addons, one item of your choice out of ten, three achievements and access to the Blessing of the Inquisition.
