Each boss unlocks the **Powerful** tier imbuements of its element.
Halls of Hope, north of Thais
Halls of Hope, north of Thais
When you hand the {item:Heavy Old Tome|Heavy Old Tomes} to {npc:Albinius} ({key:temple}): you can now use the {item:Imbuing Shrine|Imbuing Shrines}.
If your world's temple is already restored, 5 tomes are enough.
Boss by boss: when you kill the boss of each elemental portal and use the {wiki:Abandoned Imbuing Shrine} in the area, you unlock the Powerful imbuements of that element.
Elemental protection, elemental damage, skills, mana leech, life leech and critical hit.
Elemental portals of the Halls of Hope (Energy, Death, Ice, Earth, Fire and Holy)
With the temple restored, each portal (except fire) is paid for once to {npc:Albinius} with 50 items.
The Fire Portal only lets through those who have completed the whole {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}; the Ice Portal requires {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} up to *The Contactman*.
For the Energy Portal: {key:energy portal} to {npc:Albinius} and 50 {item:Marsh Stalker Feather|Marsh Stalker Feathers}.
For the Death Portal: {key:death portal} to {npc:Albinius} and 50 {item:Pelvis Bone|Pelvis Bones}.
For the Holy Portal: {key:holy portal} to {npc:Albinius} and 50 {item:Incantation Notes}.
After killing the **six bosses** of the elemental portals, the {wiki:Energy Gate} of the Halls of Hope lets you through.
The portal bosses drop pieces of the {item:Astral Shaper Rune}, with which you can tame a {creature:Stone Rhino}.
Base: immediate after the Dark Trails Quest; addons: days or weeks (depends on accumulated votes)

Rathleton's magistrate rewards those who dedicate themselves to the city. After finishing the {wiki:Dark Trails Quest}, {npc:Ezebeth} gives you the **Glooth Engineer** outfit; the two addons are earned by voting on the shortcuts, dungeons and bosses of the {wiki:Rathleton Quest} with the votes obtained in the {wiki:Oramond Quest}. You also receive the achievement **Glooth Engineer**.

A mysterious voice, the {npc:Strange Pipe}, warns that Rathleton's old enemy, Jaccus Maxxen, is back and threatens the glooth factory and the whole city. With your team you cross {wiki:Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon|Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon}, switching on machines and defeating the {creature:Deep Terror}, the {creature:Glooth Horror|Glooth Horrors}, the lava room and finally {creature:Professor Maxxen}. You receive a bag with a {item:Glooth Glider Blueprint}, permanent access to the whole dungeon and its bosses, and the achievement **The Professor's Nut**.
Strange Pipe, at the bottom of the Underground Glooth Factory
Strange Pipe, at the bottom of the Underground Glooth Factory
All areas of Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon

On completing the quest (after defeating {creature:Professor Maxxen}); the three {item:Magic Forcefield|Magic Forcefields} east of the first room let you skip puzzles and bosses and go straight to hunting or killing a specific boss.
You need Premium and the Squire rank in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}.
On completing the quest: you can kill the bosses inside again using the shortcuts in the first room.
Killing Raging Fires for charm points
They give **50** charm points; they do not count before you complete the quest.
Ongoing: each mission takes 30–90 min; each repeatable task 10–60 min

A set of missions and repeatable tasks in Rathleton and Oramond (also called Rathleton Tasks or Glooth Factory Quest). You help scientists, guards and citizens fight bandits, minotaurs, mutated glooth and other problems of the city. Each mission or task gives voting rights in the {wiki:Rathleton Magistrate|Rathleton Magistrate}, which you use to rank up in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest|Rathleton Quest}.
Terrence, Workshop Quarter of Rathleton (tasks without rank)
Terrence, Workshop Quarter of Rathleton (tasks without rank)
Each mission or task gives voting rights in the {wiki:Rathleton Magistrate|Rathleton Magistrate}: 50 for Commoner, 150 for Inhabitant, 300 for Citizen and 500 for Squire.
Necrometer from the Dark Trails Quest
After doing the **Probing** task from {npc:Doubleday}, {npc:Jondrin} will give you the {item:Necrometer}.
The {wiki:Dark Trails Quest|Dark Trails Quest} also asks for other tasks from this quest (for example The Ancient Sewers).
20 min to 2 h per task; the server takes weeks to unlock all the stages

An island full of nightmare creatures was discovered by the Inquisition. This quest is a set of tasks in Roshamuul that advance a **permanent world change** of the server: first the bridge of Lower Roshamuul is rebuilt, then the wall of Guzzlemaw Valley is torn down and finally {creature:Gaz'haragoth} is killed in Upper Roshamuul. Along the way you earn Inquisition Gold, {item:Essence of Dread|Essences of Dread}, {item:Cluster of Solace|Clusters of Solace} and {item:Essence of Wishful Thinking|Essences of Wishful Thinking}, which are used to craft and upgrade {wiki:Umbral Items|Umbral Items}.
Server **Stage 2**: when the Lower Roshamuul bridge is repaired (Mortar handed in and monsters killed in Lower Roshamuul).
Permanent world change for the whole server; it only changes at Server Save.
Upper Roshamuul (with Roshamuul Prison, Roshamuul Mines and Roshamuul Cistern)
Server **Stage 3**: when the wall in the north of Guzzlemaw Valley is torn down through the valley's tasks.
Permanent world change for the whole server; Roshamuul citizens can go directly to the Upper Roshamuul temple.
NPCs of the city of Upper Roshamuul
Server **Stage 4**: after {creature:Gaz'haragoth} is killed at the top of the central mountain of Upper Roshamuul.
Opens when the server completes the task *Soothing Bad Dreams* 20 times.
Temporary world change with no warning; it is rarely open.
With the {item:Essence of Dread|Essences of Dread}, {item:Cluster of Solace|Clusters of Solace} and {item:Essence of Wishful Thinking|Essences of Wishful Thinking} earned in the tasks.
By doing the missions *A Cup of Tea*, *Ancient Dreams* and *Waters of Life* (from {npc:Morax}) and *Mend What's Broken* (from {npc:Dream Butterfly}).

The merchant {npc:Tarun}, in the Tiquanda jungle, has lost his brother, who followed a beautiful woman to a luxurious palace. Enter the Asura Palace, go up to the fourth floor and find his remains. You receive 3000 experience, a {item:Red Gem}, the ability to trade with Tarun and, if you have already done the Asura Palace Quest, the achievement **Lost Palace Raider**.
At the end, when you give the news to {npc:Tarun} ({key:mission}).
It is a requirement for the Within the Tides Quest.
With the {item:Asuri Talisman} (part 1 of that quest) you can use the portal in the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains|Kha'zeel Mountains} to {wiki:Marapur|Marapur}.
5 min to hand in the items (plus the time to gather them and do the First Dragon Quest)

The {wiki:Festive Outfits|Festive Outfit} is obtained in the {wiki:First Dragon Quest|First Dragon Quest}. Then {npc:Muriel}, in Thais, gives you the two addons: the first in exchange for 3 {item:Porcelain Mask|Porcelain Masks} and the second in exchange for 50 {item:Colourful Feathers}.
Several hours (includes hunting 200 Dragons, opening 5 chests and killing 4 bosses)

Annual event (14 January to 12 February) about the First Dragon, son of Garsharak. {npc:Tamoril} tells you where the four descendants of the First Dragon live: you pass the trial of each (power, treasure, knowledge and life), kill {creature:Tazhadur}, {creature:Kalyassa}, {creature:Gelidrazah the Frozen} and {creature:Zorvorax} and use their trophies to open the First Dragon Lair. At the end you face {creature:The First Dragon} as a team and earn the {wiki:Festive Outfits|Festive Outfits} and several reward chests.
Section 7: when you use the four boss trophies on the square in front of the centre of the door.
The guide states **permanent** access; the quest is an annual event (14 January to 12 February).
Several days of tasks (repeatable every 20 h) + 1–2 hours per Warzone

Gnomes and Dwarves have joined forces in the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub|Gnome Deep Hub} to face a threat from the depths. Do daily tasks for the Gnomes, Dwarves and Scouts until you have enough points, destroy a Fragile Lava Funnel and enter Warzones 4, 5 and 6 to defeat The Baron from Below, The Count of the Core and The Duke of the Depths. Defeating all three gives you the {wiki:Powerful Featherweight|Powerful Featherweight} imbuement, several achievements and access to the boss {creature:Ancient Spawn of Morgathla}.

When you have **15 task points** with the Warzone's faction (**10** if you have already defeated the bosses of Warzones 1, 2 and 3 of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest) and you destroy a {item:Fragile Lava Funnel}.
Each entry spends the points and gives **8 hours** of access. You need Premium and level 100.
After defeating the three bosses (Baron, Count and Duke) and destroying the three Lava Pumps.
After defeating the three bosses of Warzones 4, 5 and 6.
You need all three pieces of the {item:Strange Mallet}; recommended team of 15 to 30 players.
Several days (random raids and missions with a 2 h to 20 h cooldown)

{npc:Eustacio}, a merchant from Venore, wants to climb the social ladder by defeating the {wiki:Pirats}. Help him repel Pirat raids all over Tibia, discover the island of {wiki:Rascacoon}, earn the trust of the Rascoohan and face {creature:Tentugly's Head} and {creature:Ratmiral Blackwhiskers} in {wiki:The Wreckoning}. In parallel, follow the trail of a hidden Corym treasure. You receive the {wiki:Krakoloss} mount, a Familiar for your vocation, the Rascoohan outfit and two achievements.
Eustacio, at the port of Venore
Eustacio, at the port of Venore
When you reach **1500 points** with {npc:Eustacio} in the Pirat raids, he tells you about the secret passage from Issavi.
After visiting the island and talking to {npc:Tik'hi Tak'he} for the first time: ask {npc:Eustacio} for {key:shortcut} at the port of Venore; to come back, use the small boat at the island's dock.

With **1200 Trust Points** from {npc:Tik'hi Tak'he} and after defeating {creature:Tentugly's Head|Tentugly} on the first trip; after that you return on {npc:Captain Jack Rat}'s ship ({key:sail}, {key:safe}, {key:yes}) without repeating the boss.
Tik'hi Tak'he's special shop of Rascoohan goods
After you reach the Pirats' hideout (The Wreckoning).
On your first victory against {creature:Tentugly's Head|Tentugly}.
Several sessions (includes hunting for rare items and 4 bosses)

Follow in the footsteps of the old knight Galthen in three missions. In **Bounac** you find out what happened to Queen Yselda, wife of King {npc:Kesar the Younger}, and face {creature:Megasylvan Yselda}. Then you find the lost city of **Iksupan**, in Tiquanda, defeat {creature:Ahau} and, deeper down, {creature:Atab} and the {creature:Mitmah Vanguard}. You receive the {wiki:Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits|Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits}, the {wiki:Ancient Aucar Outfits|Ancient Aucar Outfits} (with addons) and three achievements.
Kesar the Younger, Bounac throne room
Kesar the Younger, Bounac throne room
In the **Galthen and the Lost Queen** mission, when you report to {npc:Kesar the Younger} what you found out about Yselda.
Shortcut between the Forest of Life and the surface of Bounac
John (Bounac), the carpenter (first addon of the Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits)
At the end of **Galthen and the Lost Queen**, when {npc:Kesar the Younger} gives you the outfit.
Only if you kept the four Megasylvan Saplings alive during the fight against Yselda.
In the **Galthen and the City of Gold** mission, when you obtain {item:The Key Intihuatac}.
In **Part II**, after defeating {creature:Ahau} and accepting the help of {npc:Ahau's Dead Chamberlain}.
In **Part II**, after defeating {creature:Ahau} and talking to {npc:Ahau's Dead Chamberlain}.
Depends on the Adventures of Galthen Quest; each addon is a boss fight (≈15–30 min)

The {wiki:Ancient Aucar Outfits|Ancient Aucar Outfits} (also called *Iks Outfit*) are obtained in the lost city of {wiki:Iksupan}, in Tiquanda, during the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest}. The base outfit comes from the idol that the boss {creature:Ahau} drops the first time; the first addon is earned by fighting Ahau again wearing the Broken Iks equipment; the second addon comes from the boss {creature:Mitmah Vanguard}.
Secret passage to Iksupan (Tiquanda, near Port Hope)
Secret passage to Iksupan (Tiquanda, near Port Hope)
Spherical teleport to the Iksupan Last Stand
After defeating Ahau, when you accept the help of {npc:Ahau's Dead Chamberlain} ({key:yes}).
Variable: depends on whether you have already done the Roshamuul Quest missions and on luck with the bosses' drops

Earn the **Dream Warden** outfit and its two addons from the NPC {npc:Eruaran}, in Roshamuul. The base outfit requires four missions of the {wiki:Roshamuul Quest|Roshamuul Quest}; addon 1 asks for a {item:Dream Warden Mask} from the Roshamuul Prison bosses and addon 2 for a {item:Dream Warden Claw}. At the end you also receive the achievement **Dream Warden**.
Several days (dozens of hours in total, with cooldowns and item gathering)

A big Kilmaresh quest in which you help the citizens of Issavi in seven independent missions: unmasking the {npc:Ambassador of Rathleton}, rituals with {npc:Kallimae}, the requests of the medusa {npc:Alyxo}, the ogres' revenge with {npc:Saideh}, {npc:Ninev}'s shark, {npc:Taya}'s oracle and the fugitives wanted by {npc:Eshaya}. At the end you put together the four pieces of the {item:The Regalia of Suon}, earn three parts of the {item:Sun Mosaic}, the {wiki:Citizen of Issavi Outfits|Citizen of Issavi Outfits}, the achievement **Sun and Sea** and access to the shortcuts to the south of Kilmaresh.
Eshaya, 2nd floor of the building north of the Issavi market
Eshaya, 2nd floor of the building north of the Issavi market
Shortcut from the Nykri Delta to the Ruins of Nuur
After completing all the missions of the quest.
Shortcut from the south of Issavi to the Salt Caves
After completing all the missions of the quest.
≈1–2 hours of travel (if you use Lai's clues, she takes a few days to reveal them)

{npc:Lai}, in Azzilon Castle, tells the legend of an adventurer who stole a fragment of the crystal of a Merudri guardian statue and hid the pieces of its miniature in three sanctuaries around the world. Find the three fragments — in Nibelor, in Zao and in Kilmaresh — and combine them with the crystal fragments on top of a rock in Kha'zeel to assemble the {item:Guardian Statue (Quest)}.

Mini world change active every day: a sandstorm in Darama reveals a teleport to the dreaded {wiki:Nightmare Isles|Nightmare Isles}. The teleport appears in one of three locations (near Drefia, in the north of the Devourer or in Kha'labal). On the islands, terrible creatures guard a {item:Nightmare Teddy}, which you can try to obtain.
One of the three possible teleport locations (near the Plague Spike)
One of the three possible teleport locations (near the Plague Spike)
Through the teleport that the sandstorm reveals in Darama: near Drefia, in the north of the Devourer or in the tar pits of Kha'labal (the server message tells you which).
The mini world change is active every day. Premium; recommended level 250+.
On the Nightmare Isles, while the mini world change is active.
≈15 min (only when the world change is active)

When the {wiki:Nightmare Isles Mini World Change} is active, a portal opens in Darama that leads to the {wiki:Nightmare Isles}. On one of the islets, guarded by six {creature:Terrorsleep|Terrorsleeps}, there is a chest of drawers that only opens for those who helped kill them. Inside is your {item:Nightmare Teddy}.
One of the 3 possible portal locations in Darama
One of the 3 possible portal locations in Darama
Several days (you need to finish the A Pirate's Tail Quest); the addons are instant with the items

The {wiki:Rascoohan Outfits|Rascoohan Outfits} are the reward for helping the Rascoohan people against the Pirats. The base outfit is received on finishing the {wiki:A Pirate's Tail Quest|A Pirate's Tail Quest} by defeating {creature:Ratmiral Blackwhiskers}; the two addons are obtained by using a {item:Soap} and a {item:Scrubbing Brush}. With both addons you earn the achievement **Honorary Rascoohan**.
Eustacio, Venore (start of the A Pirate's Tail Quest)
Eustacio, Venore (start of the A Pirate's Tail Quest)

The {wiki:Rift Warrior Outfits|Rift Warrior Outfits} are earned by completing the {wiki:Ferumbras' Ascension Quest}. The two addons are bought from {npc:Cledwyn}, each for 100 {item:Silver Token|Silver Tokens}, collected in the dungeons of {wiki:The Ruthless Seven Minions|The Ruthless Seven Minions}. At the end you also earn the achievement **Rift Warrior**.
Depends on the Secret Library Quest and on gathering the addon items

The {wiki:Battle Mage Outfits|Battle Mage Outfits} are given by {npc:Dedoras}, in Edron, to those who completed the first 6 missions of {wiki:The Secret Library Quest}. The addons cost 5 {item:Sturdy Book|Sturdy Books} (first) and 20 {item:Epaulette|Epaulettes} (second).
Many sessions (dozens of tasks to collect around 435 crystal splinters)

The gnomes suspect there is an entrance to an unknown place in the crypt beneath Kazordoon. You help the crypt guard, {npc:Brodraem Orcbeard}, to clear it, discover the rift that leads to the new areas and, with a gnome crystal shield that you keep upgrading through tasks, explore Antrum of the Fallen, Grotto of the Lost and Dwelling of the Forgotten until you defeat {creature:The Brainstealer}. You earn two {item:Eldritch Casket|Eldritch Caskets}, permission to buy more and the achievement **Some Like It Hot**.
After clearing the Kazordoon crypt (*Cursed Crypt*), {npc:Gnomevisor} gives you the level 1 crystal shield ({key:hi}, {key:expecting}, {key:splinters}, {key:missions}, {key:layer}).
Level 2 crystal shield: with 20 crystal splinters say {key:shield} to {npc:Gnomevisor}.
Level 3 crystal shield (40 splinters); the deeper floors require levels 4, 5 and 6.
After defeating {creature:The Brainstealer} and reporting to {npc:Gnomevisor}.
After defeating {creature:The Brainstealer} and reporting to {npc:Gnomevisor}.
Several days (each task has a 20-hour cooldown)

{npc:The Draccoon} escaped the clutches of the insatiable dragon Nimmersatt disguised as a cook and now wants revenge. Help him in a series of tasks all over Tibia — hunting the essence of Ratha, launching the Fryclops from a catapult, stealing crystals from demons, deciphering the language of the bonelords, sabotaging a bulltaur invasion and bringing down the Titano Dragon. At the end you earn the base outfits **Draccoon Herald**, access to the {wiki:Bulltaur Lair} and to {wiki:Nimmersatt's Breeding Ground}, with the boss {wiki:Dragon Hoard}.
Mission 9 (*Bulltaur Lair*): a new {item:Ominous Trashcan}, 1 floor below the graveyard of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} (near the entrance of {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest}), takes you to the lair.
At the end of the quest (mission 12, *Gratitude and Breeding Ground*): a new {item:Ominous Trashcan} in the {wiki:Temple of Equilibrium}, in the {wiki:Muggy Plains} (Zao), takes you there.
The teleport from the Zao Steppe to the Muggy Plains only works after the first 8 missions of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
With the quest done, in the lever room of Nimmersatt's Breeding Ground.
Seven dragons, one at a time, in 15 minutes.
Draccoon Herald addons ({wiki:Draccoon Herald Outfits Quest})
That quest requires the 20 Years a Cook Quest to be completed, which gives you the base outfit Draccoon Herald.

Something is not right in Marapur and everything points to the moon. At {npc:Saraki}'s request you gather clues across the Naga islands, discover the crater of a fallen piece of the moon, investigate the Asuri, defeat the werepanther {creature:Rakesh Moonfang} in Oskayaat and sabotage the machines of the Asura Citadel until you face {creature:The Moonsnow Magnolia}. The reward is a {item:Skewered Fish} to tame the {item:Jaracal (Mount)|Jaracal} as a mount.
*Search for the Crater* mission: {npc:Sharai} gives you access to the hidden cave ({key:hi}, {key:moon}); then use the stones to the south-east to enter.
At the end of the quest, {npc:Saraki} gives you a {item:Skewered Fish}: use it on a {creature:Jaracal} to tame it.
On taming it you earn the achievement **Six Steps Ahead**.
